A lot of folks probably don’t know this,
Peter, but Kamala Harris and I
actually go way back.

Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the
last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide
opportunities for all families.

She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our
relationship has helped shape how I view public service.

I often refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she has
always shown up for me when I needed her.

In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County
Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.

I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More
important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the
last.

And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s
first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.

Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s
message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29750?t=1011&amount=25&akid=2187%2E52803%2E7NwEyX ]Will you please chip in $25 right now toward my campaign's weekly
fundraising goal to help me defeat Republican Larry Hogan so Kamala Harris
and Tim Walz have a Democratic Senate majority on Day 1?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29750?t=1012&amount=25&akid=2187%2E52803%2E7NwEyX ]Donate $25

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29750?t=1013&amount=35&akid=2187%2E52803%2E7NwEyX ]Other Amount

This whole election cycle boils down to this,
Peter:

Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear,
overreach, and fewer rights?

Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters
who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a
country and embrace progress?

In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question.

Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be
another rubber stamp for it in the Senate.

That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November,
but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state
has ever seen, so we’re going to need a lot of resources. Which is why I’m
asking: [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29750?t=1014&amount=25&akid=2187%2E52803%2E7NwEyX ]Can you pitch in $25 today to keep Maryland blue and help
propel our country forward?

This is a pivotal moment. The future of our country is in our hands. The idea of America, the promise of our democracy -- it lies here before us. We just need to step up and turn out the voters who will stand with us and defend our fundamental rights.
Please -- RUSH $25 or more right now to educate voters, turn them out, register new voters, and make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080824_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=080824_3&amount=25]
MJ: Tim Walz Has a Stellar Record on Voting Rights [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080824_3&amount=25]
Today is the 59th anniversary of the Voting Rights act of 1965 , Team. It's fitting that today the Governor who signed Minnesota's new Voting Rights Act into law earlier this year became a candidate for Vice President of the United States.
Minnesota is a state that has long lead the fight for voting rights -- pioneering things we still fight for nationwide, like same-day registration on Election Day. Gov. Walz has signed new law after new law, guaranteeing voters access to the ballot and expanding the way voters cast their ballot in our elections, working to make every voice heard.
The Harris-Walz ticket's pro-voter, pro-democracy, and pro-election positions couldn't be clearer. Now it's up to groups like ours to make sure every voter is informed about what's at stake in this upcoming election and which candidates are in favor of voting rights while others may want to restrict our right to vote.
Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help register, educate, and turn out as many pro-voting rights voters as possible this November >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080824_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Gov. Walz's mission echoes ours: “ We know that the more people vote, the more representative our state government can be ”. He said this while signing Minnesota's Democracy for the People Act , continuing on with " This bill will strengthen our democracy, allow future voters to get engaged early, and keep our campaigns honest and fair. ”
In fact, the Harris-Walz duo may be the most pro-voting rights ticket we've seen in recent history. Voters deserve to know where every candidate stands on policies and initiatives related to voting, given the rhetoric we've seen the last few years.
We need to amplify that message. There's little time left before voting begins, so we've already begun educating voters across the country about the consequences of this election and which candidates stand up for ballot access and the right to vote.
Your $25 -- or however much you can give -- makes it possible for us to inform voters, work to increase voter participation, help register new voters, and make every vote count across the country. Please join us today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080824_3&amount=25]

I just want to take a second to re-introduce myself.

**I’m a Marine Corps veteran, blue-city Republican mayor, husband and father running for Congress in California’s battleground 9th District.**

This is one of the top seats targeted to flip from blue to red in 2024, and it’s a vital part of our strategy to protect and _expand_ our GOP House majority. That’s why **Speaker Mike Johnson** and House Republican leaders are backing my campaign.

In our primary, more voters cast their ballot for a Republican than for my Democrat opponent, Josh Harder.

Now, House Democrats have placed Harder in their **most vulnerable** category – _they know they’re in trouble._

We’re locked in a tight race, and every advantage is needed to pull ahead and flip this seat.

[**All I’m asking is for every patriot reading this to chip in just $5 to send a conservative mayor and Marine to Congress to fix the mess the left has made of America.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3da8025afc3c425db3e00df09242438d&_e=hHxwrf6v9Jj_0ywvnq5akAq4_--WVZIw8FSRsoZZOjMZWXTwcbVZkGMLHDWvBEatCYv8upGdzuZasIv-GeJi3d4Vjx-RUm8Pf9a4EE0L_KGuSi4Y-_Kr-wexqIYPLM38ezr9YUNMch6U6hdMlYPsdI43b2bvP7YdTqbCrhCIaRv05IWlh7W-c3kYzbbaT6uf7xRfjb6jW37ByyJ8npJxDKjsYdpxHja_hXM-t6U5_Qe41fhXxQ1nvWuXadKiQuruMPNbClb-GsizqX6Bk9x9eI-OyYsesD_synw_BDmgWjrdbxG4pRktlAPIg6OS81GY7vhjJOZzNx2JMIAYm6Exat5EK1UnaIwOSMLZPloaslfe5iRw-cD3dQZI4UBgDFtN)

Semper Fi,

**Kevin Lincoln**
Veteran, USMC
GOP Nominee, CA-9

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. name: Tim Sheehy
subject: I can’t tell Trump our fundraising has tanked this month
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon, and he will ask me how much money I’m raising. |
---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 89 days before Election Day.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f9c4a8c48a214d78a9255d837566e25c&_e=ksko5bXi61fZ1bCWdRjkIoRVAjRyirk8vCtXPJvzG5Edhis5PR7ASb03qwnpi-tyXwamzjp2k6tc-lt4UL7B_6clSD-38GD-1_jV9bC4Q1YNjHmfQWRZXy8pg4Yhr_1Ol2XuLVtMoy7FZiTUiiOLPZSXMf7FqXWGLzqW698GzMbZcdyQn1FeilsAdIOE1K6HbhLf1Mut7Z0kOhYZL0rIXSHN8AQR18hvYm-vu7kLRcY2dGNBN0E6CYEgORaGPHOeSS7RhJfM7ubM9NsFbit1hQ1z9rozep9qb-AM8hZNQDktCJj0R2QFQBWlo97-cORGQvgUG5FreHf0MxFXk-8AQKBx074lSennqVy4MQNbxsfiwXhYycAIzS8ftPe2OD9qEXVZGu77kUvVxkTGYRX9sRT0EQIT-mqKBrMuPW-rAf4%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Just today, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

You see, President Trump is doing me a huge favor by coming here to rally support. But despite record-breaking fundraising in July, **we’ve lost steam in the first eight days of August.**

That’s why on Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down.**[As of this morning, we’re still $27,875 short.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f9c4a8c48a214d78a9255d837566e25c&_e=ksko5bXi61fZ1bCWdRjkIoRVAjRyirk8vCtXPJvzG5Edhis5PR7ASb03qwnpi-tyXwamzjp2k6tc-lt4UL7B_6clSD-38GD-1_jV9bC4Q1YNjHmfQWRZXy8pg4Yhr_1Ol2XuLVtMoy7FZiTUiiOLPZSXMf7FqXWGLzqW698GzMbZcdyQn1FeilsAdIOE1K6HbhLf1Mut7Z0kOhYZL0rIXSHN8AQR18hvYm-vu7kLRcY2dGNBN0E6CYEgORaGPHOeSS7RhJfM7ubM9NsFbit1hR_6j9nJsP-zKSB1Tg8DfxtesXS1ioe7W969h_F0nRuwjRZIThnMcHj7lRpSOh_sUTu7AaXVhnOzhS9fJLUSpZuA5YFP3oXVg-YKjSZFNwuYHqBzbGmQkjnS4dUoAMEoDrKp6sILXeiuYG8nG1LM3go%3D)** I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him our fundraising has tanked this month.

[**CONTRIBUTE BEFORE TIM'S MEETING WITH TRUMP ->**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f9c4a8c48a214d78a9255d837566e25c&_e=ksko5bXi61fZ1bCWdRjkIoRVAjRyirk8vCtXPJvzG5Edhis5PR7ASb03qwnpi-tyXwamzjp2k6tc-lt4UL7B_6clSD-38GD-1_jV9bC4Q1YNjHmfQWRZXy8pg4Yhr_1Ol2XuLVtMoy7FZiTUiiOLPZSXMf7FqXWGLzqW698GzMbZcdyQn1FeilsAdIOE1K6HbhLf1Mut7Z0kOhYZL0rIXSHN8AQR18hvYm-vu7kLRcY2dGNBN0E6CYEgORaGPHOeSS7RhJfM7ubM9NsFbit1hQdtdPMHdWdlWRsIFBagcI_aauWbvZ_6yejtDJ6jqensxJHDdLxRYs8HAPAtX5B0Xy_39fp4eaVmYMNjTJb8IM_-0_4rumizgqCVh5wiLLwHpNAlUJRhdEfirm-kFARVHS2CINiVZ9CmJtmsW-opgiI%3D)
President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ _**How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival?**_ ”

I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month.

**[I simply cannot tell him we’re down 20% month over month.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f9c4a8c48a214d78a9255d837566e25c&_e=ksko5bXi61fZ1bCWdRjkIoRVAjRyirk8vCtXPJvzG5Edhis5PR7ASb03qwnpi-tyXwamzjp2k6tc-lt4UL7B_6clSD-38GD-1_jV9bC4Q1YNjHmfQWRZXy8pg4Yhr_1Ol2XuLVtMoy7FZiTUiiOLPZSXMf7FqXWGLzqW698GzMbZcdyQn1FeilsAdIOE1K6HbhLf1Mut7Z0kOhYZL0rIXSHN8AQR18hvYm-vu7kLRcY2dGNBN0E6CYEgORaGPHOeSS7RhJfM7ubM9NsFbit1hRNDQGCElgHJHyrf6gtGtu1gPStdjz-uHCwIa9cYOTn1KJ3dKZC66pHUA6tx8XjFhGZb1vBfv2117LJ5PFQhVMRSaGuIWMTPkZeXlGc0sxytjRvsanvQzdPNJzOwBBjrdl61FfDBN1LNMifTPVSV6d8%3D)**

Together, my opponent and outside groups supporting his campaign have reserved/spent more than 110 million dollars propping him up and attempting to destroy my good name.

A little money goes a long way in a state of barely over one million people.

clean_body: I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon, and he will ask me how much money I’m raising. | Fellow American, On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state. The proof is in the polling. Just today, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. You see, President Trump is doing me a huge favor by coming here to rally support. But despite record-breaking fundraising in July, we’ve lost steam in the first eight days of August. That’s why on Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down. I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him our fundraising has tanked this month. President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival? ” I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month. ---

Peter,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump tomorrow. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 89 days before Election Day.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3251736591a94002b226a874ac18a9a5&_e=1yZN9sEbfb0yLh77TQz9C9e1wsANJQ-snIC2h-NN6H356F_Ls-HxXLPeAGLBj1hQY9Bs-IIPSr4LuOp3b_d4TsjZoRIxXIaxjFyWYo90vWLWjYaY84QNssdXHu4P1ADLq_T0YQGqqxuCKk8PZzLPWapNCiophdABKPgmZUH1Ozv8a-YDWb7SI8ChhYEIQYS2GSUNedPRGjjFKs3xR6B5n2Z5o1rYfxTNcjG5BTqP44RuhhURwaNo7kTdp6o33nzIkBPhmmaSRM0A_2dmILedfufJUPsjNVy9oqX2i0iOSVL4V2ND4hsHgWuhiDVkgPT3UPSaiynM76m0qj1gFciE6YcUfIfBEphE-JGZC1cR7nfFozb5htZw-RPsbRgUpxoh0-v1_jXsH31M48Sb8j4imQHuO8YG4Pw1yC0vMLr0OlY%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Just today, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

You see, President Trump is doing me a huge favor by coming here to rally support. But despite record-breaking fundraising in July, **we’ve lost steam in the first eight days of August.**

That’s why on Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down.**[As of this morning, we’re still $27,875 short.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3251736591a94002b226a874ac18a9a5&_e=1yZN9sEbfb0yLh77TQz9C9e1wsANJQ-snIC2h-NN6H356F_Ls-HxXLPeAGLBj1hQY9Bs-IIPSr4LuOp3b_d4TsjZoRIxXIaxjFyWYo90vWLWjYaY84QNssdXHu4P1ADLq_T0YQGqqxuCKk8PZzLPWapNCiophdABKPgmZUH1Ozv8a-YDWb7SI8ChhYEIQYS2GSUNedPRGjjFKs3xR6B5n2Z5o1rYfxTNcjG5BTqP44RuhhURwaNo7kTdp6o33nzIkBPhmmaSRM0A_2dmILedftCIewrf3tEVp2kYks5Y6GXTBuEU9uvTpDgwKzMOuy3o4JR92IahVhLueE7nJULf-Xnfxx7e9TnB6WI66GbufY99rP6lZKnciZ3m1BILiEG-U7H7USha3xUIWL1X0yFrziScLMAnsH4Z0l_4iw5KzM8%3D)** I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him our fundraising has tanked this month.

President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ _**How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival?**_ ”

I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month.

**[I simply cannot tell him we’re down 20% month over month.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3251736591a94002b226a874ac18a9a5&_e=1yZN9sEbfb0yLh77TQz9C9e1wsANJQ-snIC2h-NN6H356F_Ls-HxXLPeAGLBj1hQY9Bs-IIPSr4LuOp3b_d4TsjZoRIxXIaxjFyWYo90vWLWjYaY84QNssdXHu4P1ADLq_T0YQGqqxuCKk8PZzLPWapNCiophdABKPgmZUH1Ozv8a-YDWb7SI8ChhYEIQYS2GSUNedPRGjjFKs3xR6B5n2Z5o1rYfxTNcjG5BTqP44RuhhURwaNo7kTdp6o33nzIkBPhmmaSRM0A_2dmILedfo4Q7-njzED1dioYp_HRcfvFKdm58PQUvbiar0MZ_XpHig_ZxUw8O9DrtbPmfWnXsgUHaAoWSEioQx9U1iYXCRMidI1aBiUyvZqFFyNjIzBEobVb2d2icSXc7qplEQiOee1M8qAWJYigrM3e_aETPug%3D)**

Together, my opponent and outside groups supporting his campaign have reserved/spent more than 110 million dollars propping him up and attempting to destroy my good name.

A little money goes a long way in a state of barely over one million people.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: VOTE NOW: Send TOP to the SXSW 2025 panel stage / VOTA AHORA: Envía TOP al escenario del panel SXSW 2025
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
VOTE to help TOP make it to the stage at SXSW 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SXSW%20graphic%202025.jpg]
GO VOTE NOW: TOP has submitted a panel proposal for SXSW 2025 — "Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building," featuring rapper and activist Tef Poe!
We know that key in our efforts to build a democracy in Texas that looks like us and shares our values, our ideas have to inspire change and be creatively shared. Being selected to participate in SXSW 2025 is one way we see shaping the larger cultural conversation about civic engagement.
Community voting for SXSW panel proposals started Tuesday, August 6, and runs through August 18.
It just takes a minute to vote!
1. Go to https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/ [https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/]
2. Click “SIGN IN” if you already have an account, or click the “CREATE ACCOUNT” button at the bottom to make a new one. Fill out the fields and submit.
3. Go to your email inbox, open the SXSW email, and click the “Confirm my account” link.
4. On the home page, click “Vote on SXSW session proposals.” In the search bar, type “Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building"
5. Click on the proposal name, and in the top right corner click the up arrow to vote!
TOP staff travel to Alabama for an inspiring Pilgrimage 2.0
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Pilgrimage%202.0.JPG]
Just as in 2023 when TOP staff and members went, another TOP staff cohort journeyed to Montgomery and Selma, Alabama – sacred sites of the Civil Rights Movement. During this pilgrimage – the second of its kind for TOP and first for these staff members – they embraced discomfort together, made breakthroughs together, upped their political education game, broke delicious bread, and evolved.
This spiritual experience in Alabama, led by TOP’s Terrance “TK” Koontz, was grounded in refining TOP's worldview by collectively calibrating our hearts and minds, as organizationally we make progress in our mission becoming pro-Black and better living out our values.
Anti-Blackness is ingrained in the foundation of this country, so it will take real intentionality and commitment to fight this. TOP understands the assignment and is up to the task.
This transformational experience was just the first step in implementing a culture where we are truly, Stronger Together.
To learn more about this staff experience and TOP’s Stronger Together work, contact TK at tkoontz@organizetexas.org [tkoontz@organizetexas.org] .
An electoral vibe shift is underway
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20Walz%20rally.jpg]
The Democratic presidential ticket is now set, and you can feel the energy of campaign season in the air. On Tuesday, Vice President Kamala Harris chose Tim Walz, the two-term Minnesota governor, to serve as her vice president as the two will now go toe-to-toe with MAGA extremists Donald Trump and JD Vance.
Known for passing progressive-friendly policies as governor, Tim Walz provides a boost to get-out-the-vote efforts to keep the twice-impeached racist out of the White House.
Have family members or friends who are still on the fence about voting this election? Tell them to get off the sidelines by making sure they're registered to vote! [https://www.vote.org/]
Stay tuned for more get-out-the-vote news from TOP PAC as we get closer to November.
TOP Tips: Save cash on school supplies this Texas tax-free weekend
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20family%20back%20to%20school%20backpack.JPEG]
Families face the budget crunch of purchasing back-to-school supplies each and every year. And that's on top of back-to-school clothes. While some GOP officials would beg to differ, no child should go without the basic materials they need to succeed in the classroom. Find a list of school supplies that will be tax-free in Texas this weekend. [https://www.statesman.com/story/news/state/2024/08/05/texas-tax-free-weekend-2024-back-to-school-supplies-sale-tax-holiday/74670948007/]
Español
VOTA para ayudar a TOP a llegar al escenario del SXSW 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SXSW%20graphic%202025.jpg]
SALGA A VOTAR AHORA: TOP ha presentado una propuesta de panel para SXSW 2025: "Arte y cultura como catalizadores para la construcción del movimiento progresista", con el rapero y activista Tef Poe.
Sabemos que, para construir una democracia en Texas que se parezca a nosotros y comparta nuestros valores, nuestras ideas deben inspirar el cambio y compartirse creativamente. Ser seleccionados para participar en SXSW 2025 es una forma en que vemos moldear la conversación cultural más amplia sobre la participación cívica.
La votación de la comunidad para las propuestas del panel SXSW comenzó el martes 6 de agosto y se extenderá hasta el 18 de agosto.
¡Solo toma un minuto votar!
1. Vaya a https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/ [https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/]
2. Haga clic en "SIGN IN" si ya tiene una cuenta, o haga clic en el botón "CREATE ACCOUNT" en la parte inferior para crear una nueva. Complete la forma y envíe.
3. Vaya a la bandeja de entrada de su correo electrónico, abra el correo electrónico de SXSW y haga clic en el enlace "Confirm my account."
4. En la página de inicio, haga clic en "Vote on SXSW session proposals." En la barra de búsqueda, escriba " Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building ."
5. Haga clic en el nombre de la propuesta y, en la esquina superior derecha, haga clic en la flecha hacia arriba para votar.
El personal de TOP viaja a Alabama para una inspiradora Peregrinación 2.0
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Pilgrimage%202.0.JPG]
Al igual que en 2023, cuando el personal y los miembros de TOP fueron, otro grupo de personal de TOP viajó a Montgomery y Selma, Alabama, lugares sagrados del Movimiento por los Derechos Civiles. Durante esta peregrinación, la segunda de su tipo para TOP y la primera para estos miembros del personal, abrazaron juntos la incomodidad, lograron avances juntos, mejoraron su sonocimientode educación política, partieron un pan delicioso y evolucionaron.
Esta experiencia espiritual en Alabama, dirigida por Terrance “TK” Koontz de TOP, se basó en refinar la visión del mundo de TOP calibrando colectivamente nuestros corazones y mentes, a medida que organizacionalmente avanzamos en nuestra misión de convertirnos en pro-negros y vivir mejor nuestros valores.
El racismo contra la comunidad negra está arraigado en los cimientos de este país, por lo que se necesitará verdadera intencionalidad y compromiso para combatirlo. TOP entiende la tarea y está listo para afrontarla.
Esta experiencia transformadora fue solo el primer paso para implementar una cultura en la que juntos seamos verdaderamente más fuertes.
Para obtener más información sobre la experiencia de este personal y el trabajo de TOP Stronger Together, comuníquese con TK en tkoontz@organizetexas.org [tkoontz@organizetexas.org] .
Se está produciendo un cambio de ambiente electoral
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20Walz%20rally.jpg]
La candidatura presidencial demócrata ya está preparada y se puede sentir en el aire la energía de la temporada de campaña. El martes, la vicepresidenta Kamala Harris eligió a Tim Walz, gobernador de Minnesota durante dos mandatos, para que fuera su vicepresidente , ya que ahora los dos se enfrentarán cara a cara con los extremistas del MAGA, Donald Trump y JD Vance.
Conocido por aprobar políticas progresistas como gobernador, Tim Walz brinda un impulso a los esfuerzos para incentivar el voto y mantener al racista que ha sido destituido dos veces fuera de la Casa Blanca.
¿Tiene familiares o amigos que todavía no saben si votar en estas elecciones? ¡Dígales que se mantengan al margen asegurándose de que estén registrados para votar! [https://www.vote.org/]
Estén atentos a más noticias de TOP PAC sobre cómo conseguir la votación a medida que nos acercamos a noviembre.
Consejos de TOP: Ahorre dinero en útiles escolares este fin de semana libre de impuestos en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20family%20back%20to%20school%20backpack.JPEG]
Las familias enfrentan la crisis presupuestaria al comprar útiles escolares todos los años. Y eso se suma a la ropa de regreso a clases. Si bien algunos funcionarios republicanos no estarían de acuerdo, ningún niño debería quedarse sin los materiales básicos que necesita para tener éxito en el aula. Encuentre una lista de útiles escolares que estarán libres de impuestos en Texas este fin de semana. [https://www.statesman.com/story/news/state/2024/08/05/texas-tax-free-weekend-2024-back-to-school-supplies-sale-tax-holiday/74670948007/]
Copyright (C) 2024 Texas Organizing Project. All rights reserved.

Texas Organizing Project
700 S. Zarzamora, Suite 212
San Antonio, TX 78207
United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: https://secure.everyaction.com/p/_pdeZq7FqkSM3uHo3kegbw2?unsubscribedata=9dkmgWWD0Bx5crtLiUulxygqM89gO1b%2FeW4ULVE%2FvW9rUQqbkkIY4GBcBKSOqIOTQW%2BWz%2Buz7lKepBxjxffgyQIF0xP4CcdelK1yri5Hwz%2FcxgBKriUtBY2mTB3pTi7iupcu9Qw31fUxT4MeZRVGv6S0f%2B6vXF6HqX0wSSRVCM0KO%2B2op%2Bi2VjRwJ%2F4uMroOEcEfO312rAS6cnJaTiBWNVFekbMdeVsa3g9j%2Fozy83PH%2BUNIbY%2Fs0G4dG4Gfi3bm8n7BspqjPja9JhV5izD97WR%2BKBvd5H3Rknu38s2EP77poy6X7eiBb20fYf0prQEGZgdi6UgRAc6Jy0iI1rXDjRm%2FsvwOqvf9oMspbpzEI37GLhNGkgOa9BJbbhExTJc0VwsCCW50YW5f8oRB%2F%2B2WeDNQsxWseAA%2FtpiGyj4gYrw%3D .

[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ze1lmh0jlr5pra232sqg6ng37klcpfpcn6vpjp8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chieao74cth2bs)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

body:

| |

Dear Friend of Liberty,

Do you think boys should be allowed in girls' locker rooms?

The Biden-Harris Administration's new Title IX regulations aim to make that legal by redefining "sex discrimination" to include all forms of gender identity. This change threatens the privacy rights of all students, and punishes anyone who speaks up for their safety and privacy.

We've stepped up to fight these regulations alongside Moms For Liberty, who are courageously challenging these new Title IX rules in court.

This battle is not just about regulations; it's about safeguarding our children's privacy and your parental rights.

We need your immediate support. Will you sign our petition today?

[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/moms-for-liberty-petition/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za036j84g33rb3hoamrma6odf0acfdboi7pdduoo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chie6pr2c3h2bs)

Sign the petition now and join us in this essential fight.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zihrl91gm7kkl3qt822u5qtlgkp7coev1505k1ho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chieeor0shh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the “sausage is made” in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here’s a preview: It’s a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we’re going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t,”** to do just that.****
---
| | And right now—for a limited time—this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z47fm30fkkebj07ba1eagam36q29q73lhgj9r38g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chieeor0shh2bs)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders’ understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. You can get your DVD box set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.
---

---
| | And by doing so, your gift will also support our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts that **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans nationwide. As you may know, these online courses, including **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, are only possible because of the **generous support** from donors like you. Your gift matters because we do not take a dime—NOT EVEN ONE PENNY!—from the government. Even indirectly in the form of student grants and loans. **So, will you help us reach and teach millions of Americans with free online courses and other educational programs by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more today?** Your gift makes a huge difference in maintaining our independence and critical educational outreach efforts. And remember, when you do, you’ll also receive your DVD set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t.”** But only a limited number of these DVDs are available, so be sure to reserve your copy now using this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlp0gheq20p40ejp32qptr6vatp2dlfsm5cin6so_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chieeor0shh2bs)** In this critical time for America, when Congress seems so dysfunctional, we are deeply grateful for your friendship and support. name: Jeff Frazee
subject: The greatest threat to our nation (That no one is talking about)
body:
Our country's bedrock values of liberty, justice, and limited government are under assault.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |

| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6c07l7p94a5pbjg5lb70bhtm974oaopjrgauo0g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chieeor1clh2bs)
Friend,

I probably don’t have to tell you this, but it’s clear to me the United States is at a crossroads, facing an unprecedented constitutional crisis.

The recent attempted assassination of Donald Trump is not just an isolated incident — it's a symptom of a nation straying dangerously far from the principles enshrined by our Founding Fathers.

Our country's bedrock values of liberty, justice, and limited government are under assault.

**They have been for some time.**

In his timeless classic _"The Law,"_ Frederic Bastiat profoundly illustrated that the more unequally laws are enforced, the more emotionally and personally invested people become in political outcomes. This breeds division, unrest, and, ultimately, the erosion of our freedoms.

We see this playing out nationwide as political tensions escalate and trust in our institutions wanes.

Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is at the forefront of a crucial mission to reverse this dangerous trend and restore our constitutional roots.

[Heard enough? Support our grassroots and activist training efforts to stop the descent into constitutional anarchy. I’ve set a goal to get 500 new donors in the next 48 hours- will you help us reach that goal? If you’ve never heard of Young Americans for Liberty, you might wonder, _"What is YAL, and how can it impact my daily life?"_

I’m Jeff Frazee, founder and Chairman of Young Americans for Liberty.

YAL is the premier liberty organization in the United States of America. Since its inception, YAL has been committed to identifying, educating, training, and mobilizing passionate youth activists about making liberty win.

Our mission is clear:

**Empower the next generation to uphold the values that make America great.**

Through our efforts, we have seen substantial victories, with over 300 liberty-minded legislators making tangible changes and a long and growing track record of winning elections across the country.

But this battle is far from over.

**Consider this: every day, government overreach and unequal application of laws infringe upon our individual freedoms.**

The principles of free markets, individual liberties, and peace are not abstract concepts — they directly influence our ability to live free from unnecessary government interference.

These principles are vehemently threatened at every turn, and YAL’s mission is to defend them against tyranny at all costs.

By supporting YAL, you’re not just contributing to an organization...

You’re investing in a movement dedicated to securing a freer future for all Americans.

YAL is on the front lines of countless constitutional battles, but we can’t do it alone. We need your help, and with elections right around the corner, the time to act is NOW. With your support, we can train more students, expand our grassroots efforts, hold politicians accountable, and ensure that the principles of our Constitution are upheld.

[Will you help us defend against the relentless attacks on our rights by those who view the Constitution as a stumbling block rather than the cornerstone of our nation? Fellow Patriot,

My name is Robert Spencer. I'm an author, speaker, and expert on global Jihad and Islamic terrorism, and I wanted you to know how pro-Hamas forces are taking over higher education.

Recently, the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) blocked me from speaking to their students about Hamas' reign of terror through a Young America's Foundation (YAF) lecture. Instead of supporting free speech and open dialogue, UCLA administrators sided with radical leftist agitators and canceled the event.

UCLA's reason? They said that the ongoing pro-Hamas leftist supporters on the university grounds posed a safety hazard to the students who wanted to host and attend the event.

UCLA should have upheld law and order by clearing the encampments and prosecuting all violators to the fullest extent of the law.

**Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

The organization that invited me to speak - Young America's Foundation - is suing UCLA for this blatant violation of freedom of speech.

_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Did you know that according to a recent NBC News poll, only 15% of young people ages 18-29 say their sympathies are with Israel, and nearly 1/3 of students say they sympathize with Palestinians?

In another poll, 20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

Instead, a conservative coming to speak on campus is the UCLA administrators' greatest fear and the biggest security threat!

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

You may have heard of Young America's Foundation as the country's leading conservative youth organization for more than 60 years. YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. YAF promotes your values, such as a strong national defense, individual freedom, limited government, and freedom of speech to large student audiences.

Young America's Foundation is taking a stand against UCLA's censorship of conservative free speech.

**YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

But they can't do this alone. UCLA has vast resources and teams of lawyers preparing to defend their excuse for shutting down a conservative lecture on campus.

**Will you give $50 right now to stand with the conservative students of UCLA and fight back?** We are looking for 76 Americans to step forward today with a gift to protect conservative free speech. **And** **every dollar you give will fuel our fight to ensure that students on EVERY campus can learn the truth about Israel, Hamas, and the freedoms that make America great. **

Here's the secure link where you can quickly make your gift: **[https://secure.yaf.org/ucla-lawsuit-protect-conservative-speech](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjIyLTY1NjNiYmUzYWU1ZjQzZDFiMWEyZThmZjQ5MGI3ODFkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZS55YWYub3JnL3VjbGEtbGF3c3VpdC1wcm90ZWN0LWNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZS1zcGVlY2g_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj11Y2xhX2xhd3N1aXRfYXBwZWFsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTA1MjRfcm9iZXJ0c3BlbmNlcl9BRS1GRk81MzA0NiJ9/6yQXKjZXillOsnCsfhfPwg)**

YAF does not play around when students' First Amendment rights are infringed. YAF sued the University of California at Berkeley, and won a major freedom of speech lawsuit!

But they need your support right away!

UCLA and every other leftist university are counting on conservatives like you sitting this fight out. Thank you for taking action right now and fighting back.

| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the “sausage is made” in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here’s a preview: It’s a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we’re going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t,”** to do just that.****
---
| | And right now—for a limited time—this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0dqnev2jndv9be1vspd1mde13ee970f65kcmsn8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6chie9ob4c9h2bs)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders’ understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. You can get your DVD box set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.

subject: Babylon Bee’s Bold Plan to Get the Last Laugh
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zursfhvbej1m2l4k1h4hr7ecsiovla0205i8pth8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9g68oj6cjh2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7guc6fn93a8gp1rqui88rqjdmcbgpdlvavn4020_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9g68oj6cjh2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfdps1efee9pas81pm1joa6t0c0qj0mo9hl06rb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9g68oj6cjh2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi9scs28gn87d3n8iig7jaidjrbvo1r0eq628agg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9g68oj6cjh2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon

body:
Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/v3LWLSSri5PZAViBvcUTyw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the “sausage is made” in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here’s a preview: It’s a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we’re going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t,”** to do just that.****
---
| | And right now—for a limited time—this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/v3LWLSSri5PZAViBvcUTyw~~/AARclAA~)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders’ understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. You can get your DVD box set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.
---
| [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/v3LWLSSri5PZAViBvcUTyw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | And by doing so, your gift will also support our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts that **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans nationwide. As you may know, these online courses, including **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t”** and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, are only possible because of the **generous support** from donors like you. Your gift matters because we do not take a dime—NOT EVEN ONE PENNY!—from the government. Even indirectly in the form of student grants and loans. **So, will you help us reach and teach millions of Americans with free online courses and other educational programs by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more today?** Your gift makes a huge difference in maintaining our independence and critical educational outreach efforts. And remember, when you do, you’ll also receive your DVD set of **“Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn’t.”** But only a limited number of these DVDs are available, so be sure to reserve your copy now using this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/v3LWLSSri5PZAViBvcUTyw~~/AARclAA~)** In this critical time for America, when Congress seems so dysfunctional, we are deeply grateful for your friendship and support. On behalf of Hillsdale College, I hope you enjoy the course! Warm regards, Bill Gray, ’01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsoI2mGWNY
Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans
1:25 -
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osoI2mGWNY

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

| | | | | Peter -- Not all MAGA are as loud as others. Mike Collins is what I consider a quiet MAGA – he doesn’t shout it from the rooftops, but if you’re watching you’ll see that he votes with them, supports Donald Trump and wants to take us back to a time when anyone who wasn’t white and male was a second-class citizen. I’m Lexy Doherty and I’m running to unseat Mike Collins and reclaim my district for the people.

---
| I did what all millennials were told to do to have a good life. I went to college and studied Economic Geology – something I love, something I’m good at and something that would provide lifetime security. Right as COVID began, I turned down a good job with a good company because I saw what was happening in my community, my state (Georgia) and my country. A lot of people reevaluated their direction during the peak of COVID. Like them I decided to make a change. Now, rather than making profit for shareholders and watching wealth inequality grow, our climate collapse, and our rights stripped away, I dedicate time to helping children find their dreams and set them on the right path toward fulfilling them. But I needed to do more and that’s when I decided to challenge Mike Collins. I wish I was able to tell you something good that Rep. Collins has done for GA-10, but I can’t. He seems to spend his time supporting racists on Twitter, starting conspiracy theories about Biden “sending the shooter” to the Trump rally, trading Crypto from the House floor, and generally championing a second Trump presidency. I know you get tons of these emails everyday and I’m sorry to have to be one of them, but I can’t do it alone. Friend,

I probably don’t have to tell you this, but it’s clear to me the United States is at a crossroads, facing an unprecedented constitutional crisis.

The recent attempted assassination of Donald Trump is not just an isolated incident — it's a symptom of a nation straying dangerously far from the principles enshrined by our Founding Fathers.

Our country's bedrock values of liberty, justice, and limited government are under assault.

**They have been for some time.**

In his timeless classic _"The Law,"_ Frederic Bastiat profoundly illustrated that the more unequally laws are enforced, the more emotionally and personally invested people become in political outcomes. This breeds division, unrest, and, ultimately, the erosion of our freedoms.

We see this playing out nationwide as political tensions escalate and trust in our institutions wanes.

Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is at the forefront of a crucial mission to reverse this dangerous trend and restore our constitutional roots.

I’m Jeff Frazee, founder and Chairman of Young Americans for Liberty.

YAL is the premier liberty organization in the United States of America. Since its inception, YAL has been committed to identifying, educating, training, and mobilizing passionate youth activists about making liberty win.

Our mission is clear:

**Empower the next generation to uphold the values that make America great.**

Through our efforts, we have seen substantial victories, with over 300 liberty-minded legislators making tangible changes and a long and growing track record of winning elections across the country.

But this battle is far from over.

**Consider this: every day, government overreach and unequal application of laws infringe upon our individual freedoms.**

The principles of free markets, individual liberties, and peace are not abstract concepts — they directly influence our ability to live free from unnecessary government interference.

These principles are vehemently threatened at every turn, and YAL’s mission is to defend them against tyranny at all costs.

By supporting YAL, you’re not just contributing to an organization...

You’re investing in a movement dedicated to securing a freer future for all Americans.

YAL is on the front lines of countless constitutional battles, but we can’t do it alone. We need your help, and with elections right around the corner, the time to act is NOW. clean_body: Our country's bedrock values of liberty, justice, and limited government are under assault. |MCPREVIEWTEXT| | | | Friend, I probably don’t have to tell you this, but it’s clear to me the United States is at a crossroads, facing an unprecedented constitutional crisis. The recent attempted assassination of Donald Trump is not just an isolated incident — it's a symptom of a nation straying dangerously far from the principles enshrined by our Founding Fathers. Our country's bedrock values of liberty, justice, and limited government are under assault. They have been for some time. In his timeless classic "The Law," Frederic Bastiat profoundly illustrated that the more unequally laws are enforced, the more emotionally and personally invested people become in political outcomes. This breeds division, unrest, and, ultimately, the erosion of our freedoms. We see this playing out nationwide as political tensions escalate and trust in our institutions wanes. Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is at the forefront of a crucial mission to reverse this dangerous trend and restore our constitutional roots. If you’ve never heard of Young Americans for Liberty, you might wonder, "What is YAL, and how can it impact my daily life?" I’m Jeff Frazee, founder and Chairman of Young Americans for Liberty. YAL is the premier liberty organization in the United States of America. Since its inception, YAL has been committed to identifying, educating, training, and mobilizing passionate youth activists about making liberty win. Our mission is clear: Empower the next generation to uphold the values that make America great. Through our efforts, we have seen substantial victories, with over 300 liberty-minded legislators making tangible changes and a long and growing track record of winning elections across the country. But this battle is far from over. Consider this: every day, government overreach and unequal application of laws infringe upon our individual freedoms. The principles of free markets, individual liberties, and peace are not abstract concepts — they directly influence our ability to live free from unnecessary government interference. These principles are vehemently threatened at every turn, and YAL’s mission is to defend them against tyranny at all costs. By supporting YAL, you’re not just contributing to an organization... You’re investing in a movement dedicated to securing a freer future for all Americans. YAL is on the front lines of countless constitutional battles, but we can’t do it alone. We need your help, and with elections right around the corner, the time to act is NOW. With your support, we can train more students, expand our grassroots efforts, hold politicians accountable, and ensure that the principles of our Constitution are upheld. Join us in this critical fight. Now, more than ever, it is imperative that we unite to protect the liberties that define our nation — and protect it from those who would do us harm. Together, we can restore our Founding Fathers' vision for America — a land of liberty, justice, and opportunity for all. it's a question of how we reset
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWLIqCGW-N

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again! Make your gift & get your FREE book In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. ## Hunter Biden Accused of Aiding Romanian Oligarch
The Department of Justice alleged that [Hunter Biden was hired by Romanian](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL9G6vDACSQoKF7jzq9NqTnByboMAo3AdvL3GadOubPNzn7c5hty4nz_jzv5tpYZQ-MnzVY4AXrWffQrEdDQk1cTDKAkONlvfjHOSowQjbawuEmPOAUZIzmlYA1jzx4kaGmlU1Ia7S5mshStkW4BNSGtnZYUuZXz8lk4t43W9F2edF5C2fvkt9aO2g3_Orh2cMUj06u-1RvOxiFRB9ftkRudYuFIWTT8oirqQYExiVAeuVISZ9kxM2axPCpnqnXHLFxQizJotI2rBDcYgmVFa0bS1mDE_vTxeHFKXMep0_K-I6ffsPbnpaeHnwAAAP__TUZqNg) businessman Gabriel Popoviciu to influence U.S. government policy while his father, Joe Biden, was vice president.Prosecutors claim Hunter and his associates received over $3 million from Popoviciu between 2015 and 2017, [disguising it as a payment for real estate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO3CAQgOGnwR0WHrANBUWkyN2miaKUFobBnhOGFWZ3tW9_uquv_ptf3__benOUKO9_3Im2xbI63-iJq-aGg1pVF2xEBJQd2mEGCYMAI7rDarPpGIyOEoUGpYPSEsLkJyEnMwTfkQUBSmhhBiFGZfpx1hj0KMwGw-wwMiUwUCu1_yiU24ExvcsTa-_L2SV7tHa_mPzFYGGwuM1nfF39Xr4yg-XfXwZLLafL5DIviXZX_cEPqhj48cgNK98oYOaUY3pg9sgfF7-XRP7NYLlaqW8mFwpM_h4GmEZjRtlVG-4vSomuaWZK7Kej9D3UftR5WvgMAAD__3ZiZrM) services to avoid potential "political ramifications" for his father.Popoviciu was facing [corruption charges](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQgOGngY4IxjiGguIad7n2SgvMOJ4IQ4THOd3bn3brrf_il74_j-URqVB9_o4HBt7aElemDy5OeQV2sTKHDRFwkBjMBAMYDV7LPej7OmxrTCPencE8-TVNwwgmp2wyeC8pgAarnfZG69H62zg5zG7UPoGZIm7CaszErd9ejSrvuJV_7YP9trZDlrAzv08x_BIwC5h5x51K-WoC5o7Pq0SmVgXMa7s6qxSZC54CZuuMA6vVflXGrhJlrCq3l-rtiJViVek6qeJ5HrGqLfYoYJY95PdfKoXO-ySsfh6Rvm-Sf2T5BPgfAAD__2CxZew) in his home country at the time.This accusation is part of Hunter Biden's federal tax case. He faces charges for allegedly failing to pay $1.4 million in taxes from 2016 to 2020. The trial is scheduled for September.
## Trump and Harris Agree to Debate
The Trump and Harris campaigns [confirmed on Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8GNiJ4xsEMDF28pWtH69k8Ai0YC9NE_fsqnTuf7ob7uC03TDnt93cs5HqoC249PWiZhBWgF829C0RAAyenDAygJFjJozM44WqNCn4dxiH4cUV_9SPpYK7DphVPDiRoOUmrpBy1vYxmIj-N0q6gDFJgWpJPvbbLZ017jxTyT31Qu2y18Oxi78fJhjcGM4O5R4op5xdjMMdaaKfnyWDesByY7juDWU_KSqmFrztmL3r7Lof4woIZRcTW0ik8rdjp5fHm_PFMOafzapiW94LpL8_7vx8eDn4DAAD__2eJYBo) that both presidential candidates have agreed to a debate on September 10 on ABC.Former President Trump was first to announce the agreement during a press conference in which he also proposed two additional debates on different networks. Trump also said his campaign had agreed to a vice-presidential debate on CBS.Vice President Harris [seemed receptive to more debates](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvhCAYQH8NbBj8RJGBoYvbde1oED5OGhQCVNN_31zn217yhpf39VgfJsRwPj_Ngbr5tBrbwoXrzBQDsQrqtEcEHCjqXsIAPQfF6a69VxtK7wcxOZDWgjNWTDA6tL000tOggYPgM1c956NQ3ShndPPI1Qa9NOiJ4OhCS6X7TuFsO_r4my4snU0HjXpvLVcyfBBYCCz3fXd2qyfe9eUJLC8ksLTyc2SWS8qpYmUON9OQ7aaUUFnF3PDYsBBYaNEu3yHGUCdJBH8eJsT_Vns7fmn4CwAA___Ay1z2), telling reporters in Detroit that she would be "happy" to consider multiple debates. NBC appears to be interested in a second or third debate, and officials are said to be in conversations with both campaigns about a range of possible dates.
## Starliner Crew May Not Return This Year
NASA announced Wednesday that it has been [unable to sufficiently repair](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO8yAQhJ8Gd7aWDTFQUPwNXf72SmuN1wl3xERAYuXtTz7pumtmmpHm0_dxmS4UU9yu_-nOrq15otDiiyfT2x7VpLrFrczIp46d1HhCCWihuzk1oyKFo1GjkRJGwjkso10lhBUU2S46BFRgwEqAs7LDWRtezBnsjFITr0IBL7HlMnzmuLUbr-mdX1yGkO9dcrfWHlWc_gn0Av2-78OzUssLvY-BQF9bLm-BfuO9HkUt5k2gP24FejC_UdszfPX1QYH72qikuHHpQ-G9nzPH7SrQa6WlGTUAaIG-K2557DGlWEctFFzvFNMPV_tT0svhdwAAAP__DdRmGQ) the Boeing Starliner capsule and may not be able to bring astronauts Barry "Butch" Wilmore and Sunita "Suni" Williams home until February 2025. The original Starliner mission called for Wilmore and Williams to spend eight days in space, but a capsule [malfunction made it impossible](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGnwR0WHuMfCoorXbnbVJFSWgMMNhGGFZBd7dtHSZ36NEffx22_YYghHW94kW4-72hbeNC-csVB7rJz2hMBjR3pYYERBgFKdKee0Bnr3GitnRQKr6xUxihpvJ-9X6kLGgRIsQo1CDFJ1U_LSm6dhDIwLEieSUEutFz6zxxSO8nHV35Q6W2-uqjP1u6Vjf8YbAw2NDbRs_ZH_skMtneyZ8oxHy8GW8KK3GQK6ai8NiwxJCocays54Ver_MwX8XpHS7agbwy22nJ5sXELjo3_hwFmuUwzdEW7-zPEGOq8MCmOC0P8PWp_8jw0fAcAAP___81pnQ) for the Starliner to undock from the International Space Station. It has now been more than eight weeks since the pair launched. NASA's [primary option](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAUAH8NbLHg-TmGgaGLt3TtaPHxiKmwcW1klH9fpXO3k0466b4e88OmnLbnp13J1Fhm62u6aFY3fQOckQcTiYB6TkaO0IMUoAVfDAaFQ698kGij1NYOLjpwCq0LI7rIkwEBKJTQUogBdTeMioIahHYgR0uRoaCQajm675K2ulDMr3LR0fmy8myWWveT9R8MJgZTa61zzr8dg2mjdjKY7FGTz_RG_8TXD-0H3nXhhwl7Szmn8z4yFM_VpvxXrf8uXgZ-AwAA__9bJFNk) to bring Wilmore and Williams home involves a February 2025 SpaceX mission that would reduce its crew from four to two to make room for the stranded astronauts. If approved, Wilmore and Williams' eight day mission would extend to eight months, giving them an opportunity to spend Christmas and New Years among the stars.

| | Dear Fellow American, Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government. But do you know how the "sausage is made" in the halls of the U.S. Congress? Here's a preview: It's a far cry from the _Schoolhouse Rock!_ song many of us learned as kids. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we're going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **" Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn't," **to do just that.** **
---
| | And right now--for a limited time--this online course is available in a special DVD box set for viewing in your home or with a small group. **You can order your copy at this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/congress-thank-you](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c69fad77d6d740b3b9f6f7579168767d&_e=0WOJj3O8ne37IIwPWT9YbjAcXCWxkJXgvyfnEk5xfXQxr1PWDAsn9q2d8o8DcdnkMMoBLYF8N0dFFBUx-JVBnGgZlpQzQaDNVDXznlnQDoC85umJyg6MVGe-ypHTx0oDvHaHcy3dbMLJlMPBCVUI8iBkKLKbHQuRCGQgOLAY__SpPsUqaBvFyuP-Gv7pFSkbfr17v6kEyRsWliv4i7ypo7tqDcxVOScAZ6U2JuJmibJaExKXoDjQcfwCP1ExK-OVM2XHqGvntYSTOA7vR2ZEvrsga2C1FZrppTwgvcyy4f2EAnZOX6A2SsaWstyg0diQie4JVjBCV7vTf0lABz2IF10ByFb9XkcPRvVl5rAWIUo4FIFNIEKH-uRpCfGQkKIl02AWrSwnPrDTiBYRfX478Q%3D%3D)** The 11-lecture course explores the Founders' understanding of the legislative power and how Congress **should** work, the progressive rejection of that understanding, and how it has affected American politics. ## Large Cicada Killer Wasps Surge in Texas
Texas is experiencing [an uptick in cicada killer wasp](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OwyAQhJ8Gd1iw_gsFRRp3OemqlNYa1jYKBstwIff2p6S-akaaYj5999t0Q-ddWL9wJ51fS5zQZPek6cIVh3ZqK6tnYZWsSMsBGhC9BKg23aGUqu3kZaF-AdW1hLNECzTTIMzQVE6DgFZchJKi6xtR90PTzLZTwgqjlDGsFWRdjmedN8r0wrT43_ikszZxr7zecj4Sa64MRgZjKaXeU3hvDEYK_CcxGAOVd3z66lYM2Rn-cN7TyQumI3E8DsKTu8A_F7xsmHmO_BFiYTDiya9XGZO4f1entkdx3rvUD6wV647Of1jy_2aeGv4CAAD__46gZsc) sightings this summer, but experts clarify these are not the feared "murder hornets." [These wasps](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGypCAQAL8GMywcECEguMTsXXqhhTOjUg91C9l17--vbuOXdidd_edr-oopp2P9HXcO9b2cU8SaXjw56SWYyTQUZkW-azh0A2hQtgNotjBzp2KHOMDAvdWRjFtQkSFN2qIzTQqgwCinfKd6q1VrB61n6r0ihd4jCqOYUj1LWzeu_I7Xkv-eLy4tnnuTw1br4xL6l4BRwHjfd_u9nc__UsAYS02YWcB48H0JGPOJMQsY1xSPKnMsK8s7Xo9LYsJIUX6nnLl8mNyfhbjI7SwHVwEjuF46y1ozaumISJqZvZzJLZKc14qWONsemxLocaec02UHYdS6x5Q_ufXnea8A_wIAAP__aMFxXg), measuring up to 1.5 inches long, are emerging to hunt the noisy cicadas that have been active throughout the summer. Despite assurances from the Montgomery County Texas A&M AgriLife Extension that the increase is "normal for this time of year," the wasps' large size and appearance have drawn public attention. Experts emphasize that these beneficial insects are generally not aggressive towards humans unless threatened.

subject: Teach children to love America
body:

Fellow American,

Are you worried about the rising influence of radical ideologies in today's schools? I know I am.

That's why I have created the Little Patriots Program. This program provides curriculum for grades K-5 that teaches the REAL history of America, promoting the values of faith, liberty, community, and life that made our nation great.

This innovative approach makes learning history fun for our children while instilling in them a profound love and respect for our country. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3436a9af36e94587aa7c6a0f4cc11120&_e=rD-PNAJ1oqRH63ip0BUCsm3L_Qu5UKPWe83dRv8O--YbCzZptqZNUAgvryf9p1EMY76seRyT6JfZH3yb__jPd3k2mH8_Fxv-vh2k97JU_VaWhUFos8J7LjywWqgBbZTVNs3Q2gYIqKJkQjAKS4c91dQAERe9rihHPLDEPqrx9YTvtpZNvhu3gSwSWHe9yvU3TzlPNgDWZToLkzZWphtGfrLO86hCXwf0Opd6_vyk9as3_ms75jzat0ICSMU6JfVafNrgudXc8zMm2JdNuK22pQU7Yi7YdmAoOrAE1qcq4F8Yr_ERCAu4TlsmfhHlvKkPpqFYATPC1DA3i3n9DAhlt9fytTYJbW6aaR5Z1m2_uuU4AxJIPL097qfomFtCgkWcdmGGFc5IeDFruZO0dfkmfN_baqbczeJJNYSRBMuqkD8%3D)
__ But, in order to keep this curriculum **free of charge,** I need your support.

I have written a book, [_Why America Matters_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3436a9af36e94587aa7c6a0f4cc11120&_e=rD-PNAJ1oqRH63ip0BUCsm3L_Qu5UKPWe83dRv8O--YbCzZptqZNUAgvryf9p1EMY76seRyT6JfZH3yb__jPd3k2mH8_Fxv-vh2k97JU_VaWhUFos8J7LjywWqgBbZTVNs3Q2gYIqKJkQjAKS4c91dQAERe9rihHPLDEPqrx9YTvtpZNvhu3gSwSWHe9yvU3TzlPNgDWZToLkzZWphtGfrLO86hCXwf0Opd6_vyk9as3_ms75jzat0ICSMU6JfVaW0TEQwe81LUV9JqFl-493D8ONf5VRgLrHZ-mVYthoJ3n9VwFlTSuPcoI9yGj48XoLg6xnxzZ3EDEonfl9j9iWUJZeTLpKusy0obQZbj8D6Wgv4ypXUJn3vmkB6VxBfu2Iy8Gm5hlbOJVz_Eqk8iuRYcG83aiauLX29BD70px2H4%3D). Intended for young readers, this book creates a deeper understanding of the importance of our country and the respect that it deserves.

I want to send you a copy for a gift of $25 or more. To give a gift use this secure link: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/why-america-matters-donate](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3436a9af36e94587aa7c6a0f4cc11120&_e=rD-PNAJ1oqRH63ip0BUCsm3L_Qu5UKPWe83dRv8O--YbCzZptqZNUAgvryf9p1EMY76seRyT6JfZH3yb__jPd3k2mH8_Fxv-vh2k97JU_VaWhUFos8J7LjywWqgBbZTVNs3Q2gYIqKJkQjAKS4c91dQAERe9rihHPLDEPqrx9YTvtpZNvhu3gSwSWHe9yvU3TzlPNgDWZToLkzZWphtGfrLO86hCXwf0Opd6_vyk9as3_ms75jzat0ICSMU6JfVaA5dMsU7yhNb6YYlS-WAr8I9c1J3KZwXZp-VnqUWfHdm_nQ-HwppUDVqsCaNeLR2oTJEt6ybpbrf0Ywt34uya8bsWmVdlJo8Uc2Ofk0C9ysYfOkP73zVcfNLHU6UJhOprW7snmhz7YiEYq34y7KieK_q64cXKjl-c33r30rfshBk%3D)

All proceeds from your donation will go directly to supporting our Little Patriots Program, ensuring that we can keep creating curricula and cartoons that show the history of America.

You can help shape the minds of our future leaders today and give them the best possible resources.

Your gift of $25 or more will get you access to my book, _Why America Matters_ , and help us reach more children with the truth.

body:
Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech.

| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=686d202f0c0e47b49943b11d8eefd093&_e=5N-6xCCi_LjpCTufQGR3651m7-2V_s4RUY7cP9WNZLxtQV6LQEGZm4PJSebuuPPXCQsfOB83X32H5SZB-3_0OuWlUvqWNuHkT6hR2BRn4RXg6ZgQD1SM-cxhP88X4p0EY5PJMHJbElp5SzeKKGg8K3WwBRu8o4ycoRCngOfmp7cpT8I3G_2gRKyxQg-cV9V84i5RsuULaE9BcZG_hyt9zSmiGkl-58B0BluXl6Q8XgxucKfs0q9VXQ6Vw5xbFLl_N-YeKgcjyRMm1EN84UKtiw%3D%3D)

|

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=686d202f0c0e47b49943b11d8eefd093&_e=5N-6xCCi_LjpCTufQGR3651m7-2V_s4RUY7cP9WNZLxtQV6LQEGZm4PJSebuuPPXCQsfOB83X32H5SZB-3_0OuWlUvqWNuHkT6hR2BRn4RXg6ZgQD1SM-cxhP88X4p0EeIEOTrr0w_yQNwxy9IqIiASIA5YnQA3NQcZZfdin78IvuZrsKw8p1DT8EowpbAMLKb6SCLIKflO_rXppYyFRRJMTby-nO5KaQ2MAbRGyi23V8cDEGGLfxsbenbsnigtceWGp8WxHhESAxZKJ3zvtiQ%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=686d202f0c0e47b49943b11d8eefd093&_e=5N-6xCCi_LjpCTufQGR3651m7-2V_s4RUY7cP9WNZLxtQV6LQEGZm4PJSebuuPPXCQsfOB83X32H5SZB-3_0OuWlUvqWNuHkT6hR2BRn4RXg6ZgQD1SM-cxhP88X4p0EGlPzJVf9PBhYV6zpyG_B7q_gknuN2K-pZ8-EmZB8uLN1u1kll6kH-3DHdBt6GqdsAdjeiOl2W6xFCWl9zX94UL1Uld09Pg7lhAmVyixrY4FNfoZrTNjiNkew0g9Oqop44pmJ4t5GJf4TNL3SoawEWg%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

Dear Friend of Liberty,

Do you think boys should be allowed in girls' locker rooms?

The Biden-Harris Administration's new Title IX regulations aim to make that legal by redefining "sex discrimination" to include all forms of gender identity. This change threatens the privacy rights of all students, and punishes anyone who speaks up for their safety and privacy.

We've stepped up to fight these regulations alongside Moms For Liberty, who are courageously challenging these new Title IX rules in court.

This battle is not just about regulations; it's about safeguarding our children's privacy and your parental rights.

We need your immediate support. Will you sign our petition today?

By signing, you will protect free speech in schools and the privacy rights of all students. Together, we can resist these ideological mandates and ensure a freer America.

Sign the petition now and join us in this essential fight.

For Liberty!

Cristen Wohlgemuth

# “The Education Equalizer”

In our country, unlimited opportunities come with a good education.
We have believed and invested in our education system for hundreds of years, knowing that the next generation should be more educated and empowered to help better our country.

**But special interest groups** have a different idea about who should and should not be able to access quality education. In the 8th district, there has been an ongoing push toward voucher programs and private schooling that would directly impact the quality of public schools.

Voucher programs target parents with the hope of a private education but neglect to disclose that the voucher will not cover the entire cost of private schooling.
**Schools in rural areas have cut school weeks back to only 4 days to reduce costs in ever-increasing budgets and a lack of funding from the State government - led by Republicans.**

Families deserve access to a healthy, intellectually stimulating environment for their children to learn and grow in, regardless of their income.
They deserve the peace of mind of knowing that when their children go to school, they will be provided with facts and essential information to help them progress in the world.

_In fact_ , the term “school choice” dates back to the Civil Rights era and was used as a way to prevent communities of color from receiving the same quality education as white students in religious private schools. It was also a point of contention for some religious institutions as they argued to keep schools segregated.

**While no two families are identical, and their needs fall on a spectrum, they all deserve the ability to see their children receive a good education that sets them up for future success. This is just one of many issues that I intend to confront head-on if I am elected.**

[**So please, donate today and help us to push for better in the 8th district and see that children across all socioeconomic backgrounds are able to receive the education they deserve.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=1c020dd3cc&e=a2a46ff12c)
