name: Dr. Prasanth Reddy
subject: A little bit about me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REDDY FOR KANSAS
body:
| | | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/ea358e4360e671f23947229f28c3afba/4738c6edd703954dc3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
| | _My name is Dr. Prasanth Reddy, and I’m the Republican nominee for Kansas’ 3rd District — the race that could decide the House majority._

My story isn’t traditional.

**I never wanted to run for office, but I refuse to sit by and watch while extremist ideas and failed politicians tear our country apart.**

My life story has brought me to this point.

My family came to America from Chennai, India, on the promise of the American Dream. We arrived in Kansas when I was still a child.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/ea358e4360e671f23947229f28c3afba/5d1e62a7befba807c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
I was raised in Kansas, graduated from public schools in Kansas, and set out to live my American Dream.

For me, that meant a bachelor’s degree from Kansas State, a medical degree from the University of Kansas Medical Center, and a career in medicine.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/ea358e4360e671f23947229f28c3afba/c3fde87cf0993547c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
American citizenship is the privilege of a lifetime, and I’ve worked every day to make the most of it. I practiced medicine for more than a decade before moving to research.

When the unthinkable occurred on 9/11, my life changed. **I became a citizen, enlisted in the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and am proud to serve as a Lieutenant Colonel today. **
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/ea358e4360e671f23947229f28c3afba/8bbed751ba1935e0c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
**I’m a cancer physician, a military officer, and an immigrant. I’ve spent my career running towards, and solving, complex problems. **

That’s what we need now, not more talk from the politicians who’ve made every single problem we face even worse.

That’s been my message from the start, and the folks I’ve talked to across the district agree.

**_My opponent, Sharice Davids, isn’t getting the job done._**

_She’s voted with the Biden-Harris agenda almost 100% of the time — and she’s sat by and done nothing while they opened our southern border._

With the primary behind us, the General Election is in full swing.

**Sharice Davids and her big super PAC allies are already making huge ad buys against me, so it’s critical we have the means to set the record straight, tell my story, and build a campaign that can win.**

_**[That’s why I’m asking you to make your first donation of the General Election here, to help us win in November and bring common sense back to Congress.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/ea358e4360e671f23947229f28c3afba/b2932bdb24d5d502c3d6b838967d376c/43823)**_

Let’s win this!

---
Dr. Prasanth Reddy

**__Meet Dr. Prasanth Reddy:__** Dr. Reddy is a cancer physician and immigrant who's lived the American Dream. In the aftermath of 9/11, he answered his country's call. He became a citizen, joined the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and still serves as Lt. Colonel today. Dr. Reddy is running for Congress against a Democrat who votes with Joe Biden 100% of the time, in one of the most competitive House districts in the country. name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech.

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8aa4d3b66d84451b8ff75bf3e805b2f4&_e=yCfUoZykSwh2KjCVGA4lu_GGLJCoW6GOmmcKFMj7pJHwb3olGtZIWSswUxCRUEYfDjvjsfm6CXfNiGElbPwXi7XZZePfKb8Au8VHAeYhrv8diU6V1YgYvum87Nn9TYsXBbgDeF6vl6lSAACIs5SBZ-BE1qfn02yGfMPiBWOiWVdQQuiZCmL3V06lW_VNcsVeeG6hwACI9_dtTA8k5qfIvAP1i8-WWUe3Zi1po7PVmeJcoeqioIZTjxYGtRowu4KPz3bUEsjtD6z47FxD_WqDtQ%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8aa4d3b66d84451b8ff75bf3e805b2f4&_e=yCfUoZykSwh2KjCVGA4lu_GGLJCoW6GOmmcKFMj7pJHwb3olGtZIWSswUxCRUEYfDjvjsfm6CXfNiGElbPwXi7XZZePfKb8Au8VHAeYhrv8diU6V1YgYvum87Nn9TYsXVFD4RODo8oDfEFZfVnFRv0l8Rofm9yKvgNdPEZBrtRs74lOxsxrx_AM_zwXzgK1MFc-g6ftSYdCbzLshOx13cHhurNGNeD93M3cK3ZUmxwpWSQaPdhvlOkkfWlwuzSPcliiPW5I-HTO97yNPfH59YQ%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. Dear Friend of Liberty,

Do you think boys should be allowed in girls' locker rooms?

The Biden-Harris Administration's new Title IX regulations aim to make that legal by redefining "sex discrimination" to include all forms of gender identity. This change threatens the privacy rights of all students, and punishes anyone who speaks up for their safety and privacy.

We've stepped up to fight these regulations alongside Moms For Liberty, who are courageously challenging these new Title IX rules in court.

This battle is not just about regulations; it's about safeguarding our children's privacy and your parental rights.

We need your immediate support. Will you sign our petition today?

Cristen Wohlgemuth

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://email.win.donaldjtrump.com/c/eJw8kU_PnCAYxD8N3jD44Ap78PC2rk3eQ5P-T08EAVc2gERRaz99o9ntdZiZzI9H-uhsv9eIfUAAg9UzAkD0DQG8fYFf376bm2H4T9giljfz_vl4hY8IIO3R_Lc-W3LjpXWHyppM16A4KJWZumBAoSAMeDbUtOuI5KVS_KoLc7lyXpU905QXDKqO6MzWQKAknFwLSjmFXLMOCAHKLnDpqpKjkmw25HoM0ulHmhYfczX6zNVDSnE-J7UI2tmoZTL5ZsNk9OFA0J5uHGSyRxqr0XubkjH40SsErYt46PGJgTfp_mJvnU1y2vH60Ii2S_LCG20Xj2jzpK0OcR6XSRlEGxeFi2Lon7qSPkp7D4g2LyqRghJH-at7fWi8FmLohT7nCRdf6TEkExKizQGbDIJKBGc1ok23sfXH9PP2ez_F83K0iXf9tS8_ve_ZVOu4WefsXDFUkvux9fyltYZ_AQAA__9_EKHQ)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**

From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well. | | | | | Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me. I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind. Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream. When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into. But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life. Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable. I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies. My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation. We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility. That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs. President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support. My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part. I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation. If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST. body:
A Trump-Vance administration would be a huge setback to our movement for gun safety
#

Team -
The selection of Governor Tim Walz as Vice President Harris’ running mate serves as yet another reminder that a Trump-Vance administration would be a huge setback to our movement for gun safety.
**As a refresher, here’s JD Vance’s record on guns:**
* 👎 Vance **_opposes**_ universal background checks.

* 👎 Vance **_supports concealed carry reciprocity.**_ In states that have weakened standards for concealed carry, violent crime rates rose by 13-15 percent.

* 👎 When the Senate tried to reinstate a federal bump stock ban after the Supreme Court struck down the ATF’s ban, **_Vance called bump stocks “fake problems.”**_ Bump stocks have been used in some of the most fatal mass shootings in modern history, such as the 2017 shooting at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas.

**Meanwhile, here’s a bit about Tim Walz’s record:**
* 👍 In the US House of Representatives, Governor Walz voted to **_expand background checks**_ and to **_fund CDC research**_ into gun violence.

* 👍 As governor, he passed **_significant gun safety legislation in Minnesota,**_ including a background checks and extreme risk protection order bill.

* 👍 Governor Walz is a **_responsible gun owner,**_ giving him a special perspective on the importance of gun safety.

Governor Walz and Vice President Harris are the only candidates who will work to keep our communities safe from gun violence. We must do everything we can to elect them this November.

body:
Here is where we stand on that right now
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1751%2E135344%2ENdC4re)

Friend --
As a part of our methodical planning over the last 18 months, we have built a budget that reflects what we believe to be a winning campaign in the swingiest of swing states.
Within that budget, we have built out projections -- educated estimates about how much money we need and expect to raise for each month, week, and even day of the general election.
Here is where we stand on that right now: **Every dollar that we have raised so far has been allocated. But so has the money we haven’t raised yet.**
That means that anytime we dip below our weekly and monthly projections, we have to make difficult decisions. It would mean cutting crucial expenditures, like TV ads and voter contact operations.
**The bottom line is that every dollar we do not raise results in us reaching fewer voters.**
With everything going on in politics right now, this is not just about our race for the U.S. Senate -- although I’m confident we can win if we have the resources. It’s also about what our performance means for the rest of the ticket. Our gain is their gain, and our loss is their loss.
[**That is why I am asking you today: will you chip in $3 directly to my campaign today to help power us through this final sprint and keep Michigan blue? This would be an incredibly important moment for your support.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240809-1-900&t=2&akid=1751%2E135344%2ENdC4re)

Vince was my dog from 2011 to 2021, when he passed away from old age. And what bonded us most is we were both scrappy underdogs.
Vince Neil was rescued on the side of the road, likely after living in the woods for years. We called him a "retired cowboy" because of it. One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew.
I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college.
Vince and I both managed to find stability and a comfortable life as adults. **But in this race, I'm still the scrappy underdog.**
I'm up against a well-connected incumbent who rode his brother's coattails, takes money from corporate PACs (I don't), and rolls over for MAGA in the hopes it keeps him in power.

clean_body: A quick story that involves Mötley Crüe and a love for scrappy underdogs. | = You may have noticed the dog in the photos at the top of every email – that's Vince Neil (yes, named after the lead singer of Mötley Crüe). | = Vince was my dog from 2011 to 2021, when he passed away from old age. And what bonded us most is we were both scrappy underdogs. Vince Neil was rescued on the side of the road, likely after living in the woods for years. We called him a "retired cowboy" because of it. One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew. I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college. Vince and I both managed to find stability and a comfortable life as adults. But in this race, I'm still the scrappy underdog. I'm up against a well-connected incumbent who rode his brother's coattails, takes money from corporate PACs (I don't), and rolls over for MAGA in the hopes it keeps him in power. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = ---|---|--- = | = | = Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁 | Ashley Ehasz is a U.S. Army veteran, Apache helicopter pilot, and proudly pro-choice Democrat running to unseat Republican Brian Fitzpatrick and represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District to defend our democracy, restore reproductive rights, tackle corporate greed, advocate for bold gun safety measures, and fight for working families across southeast PA. | = = | Paid for by Ehasz for Congress Ehasz for Congress 1800 Byberry Road #1336 Bensalem, PA 19020 United States Ashley Ehasz is a former member of the U.S. Army. name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Seen these pictures before?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b1c0473b7093421ebd9b9cda4d706c27&_e=y7UoBgTtlEumw_A13eyZko61ekjMUtdWQ34OCFTQEHiaekLLY5emxqw13ACXGfNw7TOtysa-EArMDPCPvrorSAmoacXvLNTtnsmzrx7s6Heg0xe_FWey0VWyCxv6X4cmXieDyVkgsPJ3I_8dbFAVL2vlI55EzXb1vyK0nkNzalOXLLMP3EmHV6tzmPRO33IwMz7J0q4cZYprCzv3Rc2HqfjRPwt7zO8AoHlrurz5GTVTB-3TIQmVUW_P1__XfiKOqDjR_DHbCtNXFd5wc3JIxdWn6TEG4PgjRbVJ6-5rPazKHFQi0TyL4QKlbX2-R2YLTk7r9qtrCPpoPnhMlTi_tTulw3dxpNSvTGm0dTsylGo6ma7m_4CmHB97_dm2yZ5o-9URT4qWwF7u5QdnnlRMBg%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b1c0473b7093421ebd9b9cda4d706c27&_e=y7UoBgTtlEumw_A13eyZko61ekjMUtdWQ34OCFTQEHiaekLLY5emxqw13ACXGfNw7TOtysa-EArMDPCPvrorSAmoacXvLNTtnsmzrx7s6Heg0xe_FWey0VWyCxv6X4cmXieDyVkgsPJ3I_8dbFAVL2vlI55EzXb1vyK0nkNzalOXLLMP3EmHV6tzmPRO33IwMz7J0q4cZYprCzv3Rc2HqfjRPwt7zO8AoHlrurz5GTXlcYqfj1E3tHzWKKUGRn2SfZ8ZtnTxcSan5II5j_-A9vqhSHxgif0R5S2rl9ZrrXV8EybcTpt5WLB1CyEHndLtHWvsND8fugQUpBchmKs3_y1eLzbMpV4kglds5LkBa6XHj_7WdOuDQ1mtQ6dme2tW-dxFfCQ7lbXzJMgV5SG7Sw%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b1c0473b7093421ebd9b9cda4d706c27&_e=y7UoBgTtlEumw_A13eyZko61ekjMUtdWQ34OCFTQEHiaekLLY5emxqw13ACXGfNw7TOtysa-EArMDPCPvrorSAmoacXvLNTtnsmzrx7s6Heg0xe_FWey0VWyCxv6X4cmXieDyVkgsPJ3I_8dbFAVL2vlI55EzXb1vyK0nkNzalOXLLMP3EmHV6tzmPRO33IwMz7J0q4cZYprCzv3Rc2HqfjRPwt7zO8AoHlrurz5GTWgoy9I5AEYY5vnqMGiBnWfhCwQp7KaDVValOcs7Jc9tn2UwGQ0a5kjkxSXlubJqvO3GiYlwcY2W-f_ZfVPMsID07ljcm2ep5fYbztKOq7G32MP5_Wz1RIFDnLrPr5X1BeB7Lgxx-7dV7IcYpvZX0XDOBhvCyRU9HnU-h1fzwX4wQ%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b1c0473b7093421ebd9b9cda4d706c27&_e=y7UoBgTtlEumw_A13eyZko61ekjMUtdWQ34OCFTQEHiaekLLY5emxqw13ACXGfNw7TOtysa-EArMDPCPvrorSAmoacXvLNTtnsmzrx7s6Heg0xe_FWey0VWyCxv6X4cmXieDyVkgsPJ3I_8dbFAVL2vlI55EzXb1vyK0nkNzalOXLLMP3EmHV6tzmPRO33IwMz7J0q4cZYprCzv3Rc2HqfjRPwt7zO8AoHlrurz5GTXaY78O6pZRjpeNROL2_-CkIWm9Sl9QHC60nG0v2vGqJ_sWldEUw7gbaTLgGwNu-E-_75NiXwypGN7m1IsCOMQVD2EnCZiWuUNBXpshnLBRS5BQIr3yy6mEAmhHQk_6JvhYLVXcNGg0KGeTI4Iygiyltvq9XCUwV9K0OYNM02BDjw%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---

subject: Integrity and honesty above all else, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request.
| | | | |
---
| | |

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1b49f8bb-dbe2-4dce-b1eb-e0c63fb7545b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| | | | | Peter, It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request. [Can you split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress today? I ask because I know I can count on you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7f8a60f5-946a-477c-885d-3e0350c5cfd1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You probably know this already, but Eugene and I value integrity and honesty above all else. These principles guided us throughout our decades of military service. It's what compelled us to blow the whistle on Donald Trump's attempt to extort our allies in Ukraine when we overheard a concerning phone call. And now, it's what motivated Eugene to run for Congress. Eugene is running for Congress to uphold those same values and continue his fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution we both vowed to protect. And more than that, he will fight to restore and expand the fundamental rights right-wing forces have worked so hard to take away: the right to reproductive freedom, the right to vote, the right for us and our kids to live without fear of gun violence. But he can't win these fights alone. I am with him – nothing is more important to me right now. But we need you with us, standing by our side, because Trump and his allies will do whatever they can to keep him out of Washington. [So, Peter, can I count on you to split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1350bb6f-182d-476b-8d61-52366a1a1a1f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| We're at a crucial point in Eugene’s campaign and he needs all of us to rally behind him, just like he stood firm when facing off against Trump. Thank you in advance for your donation. Any help you can lend to our campaign today is greatly appreciated. — Alexander Vindman, Lt. Col. (Retired)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

Friend -- The Zoom link for the 11 am International Peace Coalition Zoom meeting is here. https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83288789255 Tonight at 8:00 pm, I will be joined by Prof. Steven Starr and Carl Osgood, to discuss what happened 79 years ago today in Nagasaki, and also the fact that war games scenarios depicting a war between Iran and Israel concluded that such a conflict would quickly lead to the use of nuclear weapons. The efforts to silence critics of the NATO escalation against Russia, such as the raid on on my friend and former UN weapons inspector Scott Ritter's home, and the harassment of former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard, placing her name on a TSA "terror watch" list, indicate that the drive to wider war is on. Join us tonight at 8pm, and tune in now, at 11 am, to hear from Helga Zepp-LaRouche and a panel of military and intelligence experts.

body:
Please help
| Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Friend, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. | | | Donald Trump held a press conference, and it proved one thing -- [he's losing his marbles](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea6da835-98ec-4759-9fec-d9bfd1a514b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). And he rambled, went off topic, and showed the classic signs of dementia. Something he's been doing more and more as of late. And yet, when you read or see a news report on Trump, there's hardly ever a straightforward statement that this guy is going nuts. Understandably, many are uncomfortable saying it straight out. But this guy could be back in the White House, and peple need to know how far gone he is *before* the election, not after. Fellow patriot,

You read that right. Apparently, Kamala Harris and Sherrod Brown are a lot closer than he wants you to believe.

**Get this:** _Sherrod Brown was once in the running to be Kamala’s Vice President._

Can you believe that? Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are the faces of everything that’s gone wrong in this country. _Open borders, sanctuary cities, lawlessness, and a failing economy._ Now, we find out that Harris and her aides were salivating during her first presidential run over the prospect of Shady Sherrod Brown being her VP.

No wonder Ohio’s been struggling under his watch – Brown has been cozying up to Kamala Harris and the far-left D.C. elites this whole time.

[ **FIRE SHERROD BROWN** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=be65a689aa084d7d84f852282f3830cc&_e=g8VXHRUBAWkI-FE8RhphSR28WQEZRtHvnqL0_CoXWfo3K5r2Y5uxsU4Ghb_emlxkTu9Qhsweq9j8UAtIzbky4TQzU_4DpC_7JLGB8Z0GSCpGm_XpUD2A646eRkWk1amVVdtrIbKPBOIAM0HXeugoY3Bcknp0_zQgxTUst9ynTCz7ab95bDyeGHduSyrcf3mOaEn4t_Js2HY-H7sDWfj_bblSrzXbb1154nWoMAcNa9-uapcmpgZ5SQ0whDEwdTrNUMXs32BSuZjDXLw26wUz-NAD2vD2OSW3dWNzpzt_2_RsuPWazC019TMjMiwZJ2WfpZ3XmZZlNklSLlKj16XrrfeXYtZsWKUyJhjZ-D1Ouk6fuYfR43_6gia3OkfMdTS0lhcY2OoOOdEHBsmNLhjorOgkKmcj1c1HZjeCBR_qqKI%3D)
**Sherrod and Kamala** don’t just share bad ideas— _they share the same agenda._ They want to turn the United States of America into Venezuela. [**And they will if we don’t stop them, fellow patriot.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=be65a689aa084d7d84f852282f3830cc&_e=g8VXHRUBAWkI-FE8RhphSR28WQEZRtHvnqL0_CoXWfo3K5r2Y5uxsU4Ghb_emlxkTu9Qhsweq9j8UAtIzbky4TQzU_4DpC_7JLGB8Z0GSCpGm_XpUD2A646eRkWk1amVVdtrIbKPBOIAM0HXeugoY3Bcknp0_zQgxTUst9ynTCz7ab95bDyeGHduSyrcf3mOaEn4t_Js2HY-H7sDWfj_bblSrzXbb1154nWoMAcNa9-uapcmpgZ5SQ0whDEwdTrNUMXs32BSuZjDXLw26wUz-EC4fczpLwx8rO0byYXm6OKSQ1vIeYN00dcIY-a3Rqfkqu6FV5BCphYSpkJFYJ11Bse21JfmNCRpYDPLjiYKlS2ecK336PSv9vm4Cef3i_j849Tt-2mQjYQfMi-ufXXPM2kx-5qGtQ-ocCttxkvbukA%3D)

Ohio deserves better. America deserves better.

In the fight,

GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=be65a689aa084d7d84f852282f3830cc&_e=g8VXHRUBAWkI-FE8RhphSR28WQEZRtHvnqL0_CoXWfo3K5r2Y5uxsU4Ghb_emlxkTu9Qhsweq9j8UAtIzbky4TQzU_4DpC_7JLGB8Z0GSCpGm_XpUD2A646eRkWk1amVVdtrIbKPBOIAM0HXeugoY3Bcknp0_zQgxTUst9ynTCz7ab95bDyeGHduSyrcf3mOaEn4t_Js2HY-H7sDWfj_bblSrzXbb1154nWoMAcNa9-uapcmpgZ5SQ0whDEwdTrNUMXs32BSuZjDXLw26wUz-L4g6_6JYlBfrRfggdBf2P77TELv2PFCg-iqAzL3DjGx4dPY5h1KG5aSBbG7YY4R3LqJGL-gKZlOQyPaKJx7bID9g4_jQSeqVlSu_nw2tIolz6v032qh7zuTW-fivvZ7OXBhCnn6RovygBZKoGv_ZK4%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

The energy in the air is real. Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz are officially on the campaign trail, and grassroots donors, volunteers, and organizers are fired up. While winning the White House is critical to our progress on climate, recent studies suggest that down-ballot races can have a significant impact on the outcome of the presidential election. Even though they’re much smaller campaigns, state and local campaigns often reach voters that the presidential campaign may not be directly targeting. That direct contact with voters can often make the difference between someone voting or staying home on Election Day. **[This is why we hope you’ll take action with us and join our JanePAC volunteer team today.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90515777/490766139/-907986478?refcode=ea.ec3bff8e-6956-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.ec3bff8e-6956-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVjM2JmZjhlLTY5NTYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l_hSoaCVFZ7BWcp2GvXo-gzKPajFJ8EE8n0WOoTt9Is=&emci=97c28a55-b155-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ec3bff8e-6956-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)** We’ve endorsed more than 60 candidates total for the House, state legislatures, and for city and county offices so far. **Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

clean_body: The Democratic monopoly in New Jersey has been ruling since before iPhones were invented. | Peter, The Democratic monopoly in New Jersey has been ruling since before iPhones were invented. It’s time to HANG UP on politics as usual in New Jersey. This old phone doesn’t work, and neither does the old way of doing things in New Jersey. Between Joe Biden and Bob Menendez, Democratic politicians have been ruling New Jersey politics for ninety years combined. Andy Kim touts himself as a “civil servant,” but that just means he has been out of the real world for too long. It’s time to move the government into the 21st century, and come up with modern-day solutions for modern-day problems. Many thanks, Curtis Bashaw Republican Nominee, United States Senate | GET TO KNOW CURTIS Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans. A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will. | If you'd like to unsubscribe, please . | PAID FOR BY CURTIS BASHAW FOR US SENATE, INC.

On Aug. 6, 1945, the United States dropped a nuclear weapon on Hiroshima, Japan killing some 140,000 innocent civilians. Three days later on this day August 9 in 1945, the United States dropped a second nuclear bomb on the city of Nagasaki, killing another 70,000 innocent civilians. Now, as the city of Nagasaki, Japan held a peace ceremony in memory of those horrific bombings, the United States boycotted. Why? Because the Mayor of Nagasaki [disinvited the Israeli ambassador](https://substack.com/redirect/f0311710-95e0-4be8-8e26-766b8e1e113f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Some today still argue that the use of these nuclear weapons was a _necessary evil_ to prevent even more death and destruction. They point to Japan's surrender less than a week later, which enabled an end to World War II, as proof that the use of nuclear weapons was the right choice. But correlation isn't causation, and the facts demonstrate that such justifications have no merit in reality. The United States was wrong to use nuclear weapons then, just as it is wrong to boycott Japan's peace ceremony now.
**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/937da5ae-ce91-4797-8666-23b721365c04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Nagasaki Peace Park, commemorating the lives lost on August 9, 1945.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147524991&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3NTI0OTkxLCJpYXQiOjE3MjMyMjA3NjgsImV4cCI6MTcyNTgxMjc2OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.F0f4_F2eHjicJoKuy-zmlsu_YnLDC7I5xKDjkbjByfA)
The facts are clear. The United States deployed nuclear weapons on Japanese civilians knowing full well they were not necessary to end the war. Consider the testimony of none other than Dwight Eisenhower, supreme allied commander, five-star general, and of course eventual president of the United States, who said:
> I was against it on two counts. First, the Japanese were ready to surrender, and it wasn't necessary to hit them with that awful thing. Second, I hated to see our country be the first to use such a weapon.
Even known racist Admiral William "Bull" Halsey, notorious during the war for his bigoted motto to "_Kill Japs, kill Japs and kill more Japs_!" [later lamented](https://substack.com/redirect/14dc0830-af6b-41f1-a397-870d6793e4ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
> The first atomic bomb was an unnecessary experiment. It was a mistake to ever drop it. [The scientists] had this toy and they wanted to try it out, so they dropped it. It killed a lot of Japs, but the Japs had put out a lot of peace feelers through Russia long before.
Likewise, as World War II historian Ian W. Toll points out, U.S. military leadership was categorically opposed to dropping nuclear weapons on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, both because it was an unnecessary strategy to end the war, and also because it was morally indefensible. [Toll writes](https://substack.com/redirect/14dc0830-af6b-41f1-a397-870d6793e4ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
> In 1945, eight Americans (four generals, four admirals) held five-star rank. Seven later stated that the bombings were either unnecessary to end the war, morally indefensible, or both. That fact is all the more arresting when you consider that their professional code discouraged second-guessing the decisions of superiors, and that they were discussing an event that had already happened, and thus could not be reversed.
Moreover, the U.S. war cabinet's instructions to drop nuclear weapons made no mention of sparing women and children--something that today would be considered a war crime. Indeed, Japan remains the only nation on Earth that has ever suffered the onslaught of nuclear weapons. Perhaps in stark memory of these atrocities, Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki declined to invite the Israeli ambassador to the Nagasaki peace ceremony.
In response, the United States, and five other nations opted to withdraw their ambassadors to stand in solidarity with Israel. In other words, the the United States refused to attend the Nagasaki peace ceremony held in memory of innocent civilians murdered with American _nuclear weapons_ to instead stand in solidarity with a nation murdering innocent civilians with American _conventional weapons_. In a word, absurd.
I admire Mayor Suzuki's moral clarity. Israel faces credible accusations of war crimes from the ICJ and ICC, extermination from the United Nations, and genocide from a plethora of world renowned human rights organizations. While America's nuclear bombs killed some 210,000 Japanese civilians, The Lancet estimates conservatively that [Israel's bombings have killed at least 186,000 Palestinian civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/bb942cd3-f80f-4581-a5ee-e751b1032b7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as of June, 2024. And just as America's bombings made no mention of sparing women and children, Israel's bombings have likewise killed tens of thousands of innocent women and children.
And despite Israel's public refusal to admit it has nuclear weapons in its arsenal, it is well documented that the State has in its possession at least 300 nuclear missiles. As the non-profit organization the Nuclear Threat Initiative ("NTI") [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/d183f82c-2116-4c39-9a7c-9cfbcfac9fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Although Israel has possessed nuclear weapons since the 1960s, it maintains a policy of nuclear opacity, never officially confirming the existence of its nuclear program. Accordingly, Israel has never signed the NPT. Israel manufactures and deploys a diverse range of technologically sophisticated ballistic missile, cruise missile, and missile defense systems.
Why should Japan invite a nation to attend a peace ceremony dedicated to abolishing nuclear weapons, when that nation is not only credibly committing war crimes on a daily basis, but refuses to abide by international law in nuclear weapons management? Mayor Suzuki lamented at the Nagasaki peace ceremony [that](https://substack.com/redirect/f0311710-95e0-4be8-8e26-766b8e1e113f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> You must face up to the reality that the very existence of nuclear weapons poses an increasing threat to humankind, and you must make a brave shift toward the abolition of nuclear weapons. The world faces a critical situation because of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and accelerating conflicts in the Middle East.
Nuclear weapons are an existential threat to humanity. No nation is truly safe as long as these weapons proliferate. The United States must lead from the front and negotiate meaningful nuclear de-proliferation on a global scale. This is not an impossible task by any means, as evidenced by the success of The Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty ([START I](https://substack.com/redirect/bfb8e419-d765-4290-8090-8a35b5e7802e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), signed in 1991. [START](https://substack.com/redirect/85eece77-510e-416e-9a4b-4a0613d12c6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) united the United States and the Soviet Union to nuclear arms reduction, and by 2001, its full implementation resulted in an 80% reduction of the world's strategic nuclear weapons.
Rather than boycott peace ceremonies committed to nuclear disarmament, the United States must revive peace talks to lead by example. The use of nuclear weapons on Hiroshima and Nagasaki was indefensible then, and refusing to act to prevent such further atrocities is indefensible today. Thus, given the United States was the first and remains the only nation on Earth to ever deploy nuclear weapons against a civilian population, it has a moral imperative to ensure it also remains the last nation to deploy nuclear weapons for any reason, period.

Three days later on this day August 9 in 1945, the United States dropped a second nuclear bomb on the city of Nagasaki, killing another 70,000 innocent civilians. Some today still argue that the use of these nuclear weapons was a necessary evil to prevent even more death and destruction. They point to Japan's surrender less than a week later, which enabled an end to World War II, as proof that the use of nuclear weapons was the right choice. But correlation isn't causation, and the facts demonstrate that such justifications have no merit in reality. I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. body:
https://www.joekerrforcongress.com/ [https://www.joekerrforcongress.com/]
Hi Peter, it’s Joe.
Early in my career, my mom said, “Joe, do everything you can, but always recognize and credit others.”
Well, I want to thank you so much for helping Team Joe Kerr hit our end-of-July goal. We couldn’t keep campaigning without you. You’re the reason why we can keep going.
I learned that lesson over and over in my life, including when I was a firefighter and fire captain — I wouldn’t be here without the support of my team. We trusted each other with our lives and because I saw what was happening on the ground, I took that trust and responsibility and translated it into law.
With the support of the force, I learned to be a voice for many.
As a labor leader, I helped pass over 200 bills with Republican and Democratic support. I'm extremely proud of that. I helped bring $1.6 billion back to the taxpayers of California's 40th Congressional district.
Fire doesn’t care whose house it burns down. Fire doesn’t stop to ask who supported what. I don’t care who you are — I’ll fight for you, and my record shows that I have always put my team over any party.
Good laws and good leadership are not about being left-leaning or right-leaning. It’s about being American-leaning. I’m focused on fighting for the good of the people. I have always been bipartisan, and I’ll bring that belief to Congress.
Help me prove it to you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_080924_mamaalwayssaid]

mid-month deadline? Montana’s Senate race will be won by a handful of
votes, and my team needs even more resources to stand up to the millions
of dollars outside groups are throwing my way.

Friend,

At this point, you’ve probably heard people call JD Vance “weird” dozens, maybe hundreds of times. As someone who consumes politics all day, I’m even getting a little sick of it. But often things are cliches because they’re true. And the truth is, there is something **genuinely unsettling** about Trump’s VP pick:
* He’s hostile to no-fault divorce and has even suggested that women should stay in violent, abusive marriages.
* He proposed that parents of children under 18 should get extra votes.
* He claimed “childless adults” are “more sociopathic” and make America “less mentally stable."
* Supports InfoWars lunatic Alex Jones, saying that he represents “important truths.”
* Admitted to being “plugged into a lot of weird right-wing subcultures.”

And it’s not just the substance of what he believes, but also the style. Vance is steeped in a particular strain of online, right-wing thought that is angry, punitive, and deeply unappealing to the great majority of American voters. And anyone who believes these far-out ideals—let alone campaigns on them—should be nowhere near the White House.
We won’t let that happen. Trump picking Vance is just one more sign that Trump is categorically unfit for office. Team –
The long-awaited trial for election denier Tina Peters has officially begun. Peters is finally facing charges in front of a jury.
In 2021, Peters became a hero to MAGA election deniers for using her role as County Clerk to breach her county’s voting equipment in the hopes of proving the Big Lie. She teamed up with the MyPillow guy -- well-known election conspiracy Mike Lindell -- in spreading disinformation about the breach.
Then, she ran for Secretary of State, hoping to defeat Jena to become Colorado’s Chief Election Officer.
If convicted, Peters could face decades in prison.
Read more about her actions and the trial here. [https://coloradosun.com/2024/08/01/tina-peters-trial-election-security-mesa-county-colorado/]
Jena has worked to preserve and protect Colorado elections, and she will continue to strengthen voting access and security as Secretary of State.
Thanks for your support.

I'm reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the transformative power of the gospel.

Our commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that the gospel reaches every corner of the world.

Fellow American,
**My parents weren’t the kind of people who put half-effort into anything.** They put everything on the line to escape communist Cuba. And when they got to America, they did _whatever_ it took to make it here. ## Highly anticipated "Whistleblower" film to premier at Whistleblowers of America conference
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
* What: Whistleblowers of America annual conference first-look at "Rebekah Jones: Whistleblower" with director Josh Fox and whistleblower Rebekah Jones
* When: Friday, September, 13, 2024, 11:00 AM - 12:30 PM EST
* Where: 1608 K Street Northwest, Washington, DC 20006

Academy Award nominated and Emmy winning director Josh Fox brings his upcoming film, "Rebekah Jones: Whistleblower" to Washington, DC. for an exclusive sneak peek, in partnership with Whistleblowers of America.
"Whistleblower" follows Florida scientist Rebekah Jones (_Forbes Technology Person of the Year, Fortune 40 Under 40, Whistleblower of the Year, and more_) as she takes on corruption and lies during the COVID-19 pandemic.
An extended first look at the film will air during [Whistleblowers of America's annual conference, the 2024 Workplace Promise Institute meeting. ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab434290-eef7-411a-aff5-fc367f367699?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Josh Fox will join Rebekah Jones for a post-screening Q&A and discussion.
The 2024 WoA-WPI conference is for whistleblowers and their allies who want to learn more about whistleblower rights and protections and join WoA's peer support network.
Attendees will hear from attorneys, government officials and advocates about the current status of laws, programs and policies that affect them and have an opportunity to influence those practices. WoA welcomes family members to participate and is in the process of developing opportunities for the children of whistleblowers to engage in a mentor program.
[Click here for tickets](https://substack.com/redirect/ab434290-eef7-411a-aff5-fc367f367699?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6e5d1ffd-9154-4f7e-b099-f46aa36790dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Director's Statement**
"Viruses are natural, pandemics are man-made" Rebekah Jones tells me. "There shouldn't be any political messaging for a virus. You need scientists running the show."
Her voice is the unmistakable truth. A voice that needs to be heard. She's strong, vulnerable, sassy, brilliant, clear headed and outspoken. But she and I both know that maybe her most valuable characteristic is that she is and always has been, trouble. The sheriff in the small Mississippi town where she grew up nicknamed her that, "Aw Trouble, is that you again!"
I always want to be around people who are big big trouble. And who know that you have to be tough as nails to endure what that trouble brings. Those are the people who change the world. They save lives, they fight for justice, they speak out when others are silent, they stick their necks out and they ride the storm that the world hurls at them time and time again. I always want to be in the center of that maelstrom.
That's why I have always valued my friendship with Rebekah, since I met her over ten years ago. I get her. Albert Maysles once told me "The whole process is a friendship, you get to know and then everyone gets to know." That's the most valuable advice I have ever had as a documentarian. Become friends with trouble, with the controversy, with the drama of life, with the spark that catches the ethos on fire, with the truth.
Rebekah refused to lie. Refusals are powerful.
When you refuse power, when you throw truth in its face, it will try to crush you with everything it has got. I understand this deep in my bones. I was public enemy number one for the oil and gas industry for a decade. They threw everything they could at me. Smear, misinformation, death threats, lies, labeling me a terrorist, a communist, a liar. I was the victim of arson, of ostracizing, of surveillance, physical intimidation, PSYOPS campaigns, arrest, stalking, of public and private attacks on a daily basis. Rebekah has faced all of that and worse, sexism, misogyny, threats of rape and degradation, spurious and insubstantiated smear campaigns that label her a whore, a porn star, a cyber stalker, a psycho.
The smear and misinformation machine that continues to take aim at Rebekah is not only the most nefarious force in our country, in our democracy, but it is also the man-made element of this pandemic. Viral misinformation has become _viral_ misinformation.
There is only one way out of the culture wars that the likes of Desantis have brought us- science and truth. But huge numbers of people, who have been steeped in misinformation and smears for years may stop us from regaining our sanity as a society. The misinformation _has become_ the disease.
As we follow Rebekah in her fight to clear her name, she is fighting for much more- for science, for women, for women scientists, for children, for health, for democracy.
Rebekah's refusal put her in the spotlight and she hasn't stopped outshining it.
She has the right stuff for it. She has the toughness and the charm, the bluntness and the charisma, the brains and the beauty, the sass and the stillness. She's human and real and flawed and vulnerable and unafraid. She's determined. Every time I mention her to someone their face lights up- "WOW, she's amazing! The'y say." She makes people feel like there is someone fighting for them.
I think she is a true American hero. This world needs heroes. And it needs _films_ about heroes. We need inspiration to battle the constant barrage of lies, smears and greed.
Let's go make some trouble.
-- Josh

The conference is for whistleblowers who want to learn more about their rights and protections and be part of a peer support network. Those who attend the conference will share with other whistleblowers and survivors about their lessons learned and strategies for coping and resilience. They will hear from attorneys, government officials and advocates about the current status of laws, programs and policies that affect them and have an opportunity to influence those practices.

The WPI will also include discussion on Whistleblower Protection advocate certification, announce Giraffe Award winners and will walk to the White House in solidarity for the President to recognize whistleblowers with a Rose Garden Ceremony on July 30th, National Whistleblower Day.

After two weeks of Kamala controlling the narrative - Trump reclaimed it at the presser yesterday -- he immediately agreed to 3 debates (Sept 4 Fox, Sept 10 NBC, and Sept 25 ABC) - and put Kamala on defense to hold a presser. Notice how Fox is first in the list of debates -- smart move by him. If she (who was claiming he was scared to debate) doesn't agree to the first, he won't agree to the last. It's crazy to debate on ABC where they are open in opposing him, but by making it last on the list it was smart. The list of moderators is also going to be important -- the media realizes that they have to stop Trump -- CNN gave a venue to push out Biden so they have to do everything now to continue their pro-Harris support. Must stop Trump.
BTW, as for the Harris "Trump is scared" attack...think about this -- he debated Biden at a left-leaning outlet (ABC) with rules set by Biden to favor Biden and won, he took questions at a VERY hostile National Association of Black Journalist conference (which Harris skipped), survived an assassination attempt (and jumped up after getting shot) and did an hour-long presser taking almost 40 questions from a hostile press....all the while Kamala has had one (60 seconds of word salad on the tarmac at Andrews AFB that did not go well) unscripted moment.
## Walz's military record...
I have more to say on the Walz pick below, but I wanted to make sure everyone sees this:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2f72c19-4995-4b98-89d8-892bcde794ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**" On its website, the Harris campaign axed a reference to Walz as a "retired command sergeant major" and now says that he once served at the command sergeant major rank -- a small change that nonetheless reflects his true rank at retirement from the Army National Guard."**
To be clear, this isn't a "tweak" Politico (reminder one of the authors of their morning Playbook is a defacto Kamala spox) - this is an admission of guilt.
This letter from members of his former Guard unit lays out this issues at stake. They wrote this when he first ran for Minnesota Governor but its gotten new legs since he has been tapped by Harris.

An election-integrity review by Gov. Glenn Youngkin found 6,303 non-citizens and 79,867 dead people on Virginia's voter rolls VA's election in 2021 was decided by less than that amount. VA is one of only 3 states to require SSNs on voter registrations.
> My take on illegal immigration: if you allow people into the country illegally, then give them a license - which is what is required to vote.....what do you think is going to happen. In Virginia the AG and Gov took some action to make sure Virgina's elections remained secure.

Hey there, This was urgent, we had to reach out. Nikki recently led a bipartisan call to Postmaster Louis DeJoy, demanding timely mail deliveries and the protection of postal workers' jobs. The recent changes implemented by USPS have disrupted deliveries, impacted efficiency, and put jobs at risk in communities across the US, including right here in the 13th District. As a representative for Illinois’ 13th Congressional District, Nikki understands the crucial role that efficient postal services play in our communities. That's why we need strong, grassroots support from individuals like you to help us get this across the finish line. [**Will you sign your name right now and stand with Nikki in her call to protect postal workers and ensure timely mail delivery? Your support can make a real difference for our communities.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90522045/490787660/-1734346106?refcode=AU_NJB_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240809_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTNjYTQ5OC03MzU2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7utpJHTTNDCG616qIleigCiJXqG71ClEXAx8aD2VNMo=&emci=a743c6b1-6556-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=453ca498-7356-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=13891387) | [SIGN YOUR NAME ➔](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90522049/490787662/-1734346106?refcode=AU_NJB_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240809_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTNjYTQ5OC03MzU2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7utpJHTTNDCG616qIleigCiJXqG71ClEXAx8aD2VNMo=&emci=a743c6b1-6556-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=453ca498-7356-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=13891387)

Our postal system is the lifeblood of our democracy, connecting people, families, and businesses across the country. It's how we stay connected, how we receive crucial medications, pay our bills, and exercise our right to vote.
But right now, these services are under threat. We can't afford to stand idly by while our postal workers face job insecurity and our communities are left waiting for important mail. **We need to act now!**
Nikki is committed to fighting for the hardworking folks who keep our postal system running smoothly. She will work tirelessly to ensure that our mail is delivered on time and that no postal worker is left behind.

I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: re: AIPAC thinks it can interfere in Democratic primaries like mine
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, I’ll be direct.

My Democratic primary election for Minnesota’s 5th congressional district
is just four days away, and winning re-election requires a lot of
resources.

AIPAC alone has committed to spend over $100 million interfering in
Democratic primaries like mine this year, and they already unseated my
brother and sister in service, Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush.

The right wing and their super PACs would love nothing more than to defeat
our progressive movement. Can I count on your support to stop
them, Peter?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240809-io.r2wh7A&refcode=em20240809-35894&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35894%2E1203867%2E70B3x5 ]Please split a contribution of any amount today between Justice
Democrats and my campaign to help me and my fellow Squad members defend
our seats against AIPAC’s millions.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240809-io.r2wh7A&refcode=em20240809-35894&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=35894%2E1203867%2E70B3x5 ]Contribute $5

Organizing is part of who I am. When I was 14, I was an interpreter for my
grandfather at local DFL caucuses and saw neighbors come together to
advocate for change. Before I served in the state legislature, I worked as
a nutrition educator at the University of Minnesota and have been a
committed organizer in the DFL party for years.

In 2018, we made history together when this people-powered movement
elected me the first African refugee to become a member of Congress, the
first woman of color to represent Minnesota, and one of the first two
Muslim-American women elected to Congress.

Since then, I’ve spent my time in Washington focused on fighting for
Minnesota’s progressive values, including delivering over $54 million to
my district in the form of community projects, as well as passing funding
to feed nearly 30 million children across the country during the pandemic,
the largest climate bill in U.S. history, and the most significant gun
safety legislation in over thirty years.

Now, my opponent from 2022 is challenging me again, so we need to fight
back against even more bigoted attack ads blanketing the airwaves and more
lies and disinformation on social media. I narrowly won last time by only
2 percent of the vote, so we know it’s going to be close again.

I am committing to continuing the fight for Medicare for All, a Green New
Deal, raising the minimum wage, canceling student debt, and banning
assault weapons, as well as establishing a permanent ceasefire and release
of all hostages in Gaza.

There’s no doubt that these values have put a target on me from
Republicans and their corporate allies. AIPAC and their network of
right-wing megadonors have made it their mission to oust Squad members
like me from office this year by spending an unprecedented $100 million.

I don’t take a single dime from corporate PACs, so I’m relying on
supporters like you chipping in.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240809-io.r2wh7A&refcode=em20240809-35894&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35894%2E1203867%2E70B3x5 ]Will you help me fight back and win this critical primary on Tuesday
by splitting a contribution between my campaign and Justice Democrats
today?

Thank you for everything you do to push our collective, progressive
movement forward in this critical moment.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. | | I believe that you cannot have a big league economy with little league infrastructure. That is why I am always so excited to share Washington state's funding wins from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. **Thus far, we have earned funding for upwards of 800 projects, totaling $8.9 billion.** In June, I secured a $17,931,000 grant from the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) for the Port of Bellingham to renovate a shipping terminal site. With this grant, the Port of Bellingham will be able to return the site to a fully functioning multimodal terminal with more efficient loading and unloading of railcars. This is big because, in Washington state, transportation means jobs. **Thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the Port of Bellingham has the funding it needs to modernize its shipping terminal, which will create more jobs, reduce carbon emissions, and keep supply chains and the maritime economy moving.** In addition to the $17.9 million grant from June — since 2022, I have secured over $82 million for Northwest Washington thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law RAISE grants. This money has been used to invest in local infrastructure projects from Lynnwood's Poplar Way Bridge, to Whatcom County's Lummi Island Ferry, to Blaine's Bell Road Project, to the Tulalip Tribes' Road Safety Project. **The projects underway here in Northwest Washington and nationwide will help create jobs and pave the way for cleaner, greener, safer and more accessible infrastructure for Americans.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: Pennsylvania Forward Party August Newsletter
body:
Thank you!

|
#
## ****
## **Thank you to everyone that helped collect signatures. We did it!**
Since kicking off our signature collection effort on Primary day, volunteers from across the state asked their friends and neighbors to help get our candidates on the ballot this November. Eric Settle and Chris Foster will be on every Pennsylvanian's ballot and will help us become a Recognized Minor Party in this state. Read [full statements](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwzIv1-f3NESnDnLhMSVNVYDB5KrJstpkMOHrwsWKSEsrTcTd73ScuemopTCms6s6g&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=1) about making the ballot from Eric and Chris. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwzIv1-f3NESnDnLhMSVNVYDB5KrJstpkMOHrwsWKSEsrTcTd73ScuemopTCms6s6g&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=2) "It has been great to meet so many of you who started and supported this party to try to find a way to create a new political movement that looks at both major parties and says: There has to be a better way to solve our problems." -Eric Settle "Despite the frustration many feel with the current political landscape, our commitment to civility in political discourse and our avoidance of entrenched partisan ideas have been a breath of fresh air for the public." \- Chris Foster
##
## What's next?
We've never had a better opportunity than right now to organize across the state. We need to get the word out over the next few months and especially on election day. Many of us have volunteered for campaigns before, for many, it's our first time. Either way, we need your experience and energy. Gathering signatures has shown use that people are receptive to our message, we just need people to deliver it. Contact us to find out how YOU can help us reach 2% (or more) on Election Day. Committing even one hour can be incredibly effective.
* * *
## **Support Our Candidates**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/settle_eric_r?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=3)[](https://home.forwardparty.com/foster_chris?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=4)[](https://home.forwardparty.com/gaydos_val?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=5)[](https://home.forwardparty.com/schroy_cameron?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=6)[](https://home.forwardparty.com/almoney_dan?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=7)[](https://home.forwardparty.com/endorsements?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_august_newsletter&n=8) Join us August 19th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call to talk about how we support our candidates of the next few months and why it's so important. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I need to raise an additional $8,733 before Trump lands in Montana |
---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note - with a follow-up yesterday - letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump today. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 88 days before Election Day.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=15c5306b0de744a6b6e264da23fd8213&_e=b4crRsGBcBMhKtEsVCQRseenCuWV3WmAExBwc-eNQHBjXfC98HhJB4pnHlgp_LTn--o-W9sjm6D9hn5EQPElEyneFwLcDdErMx0RBLRvaPhV8VbRC6YDwKb0kkeoEwrgHL96RepfoeBhOBJuttZchxhL8Yu4lpKNMLVVmYz7IBM_3XZ2SHJAOlQ05WX4eub364bG3kHCBd1FuiZbyLqFKrQoroaJNEbN_yzQud4mgp0Ts7iwfnCbP94AdpRxOw0ZF_tsWTNAMe20MyJl3QTgfonyiQlE98HIGXHjgqZ8jE34C8UDaTBL1pvsTATTitT-gJrCREnEHx2oKAKdltxcm_beZCVYSSgaymSY1rcowQV1a-WQ5lxAEAXEdi4cO0szhM-1JArgJTBU6cartL4NgskNV1Q2fq1z3FcvTTXsi48%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Yesterday, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

On Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down.**[Trump is now on his way, and we’re STILL $8,733 short.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=15c5306b0de744a6b6e264da23fd8213&_e=b4crRsGBcBMhKtEsVCQRseenCuWV3WmAExBwc-eNQHBjXfC98HhJB4pnHlgp_LTn--o-W9sjm6D9hn5EQPElEyneFwLcDdErMx0RBLRvaPhV8VbRC6YDwKb0kkeoEwrgHL96RepfoeBhOBJuttZchxhL8Yu4lpKNMLVVmYz7IBM_3XZ2SHJAOlQ05WX4eub364bG3kHCBd1FuiZbyLqFKrQoroaJNEbN_yzQud4mgp0Ts7iwfnCbP94AdpRxOw0ZT3xxjUXR16lf3ep_WnDUzcyCBl4rpkM_knTcRT9Dp062lp1aT2tNd2chH07CS2L2FeE78VTDaH6Ziz7rnaMLwoCFqXRmDKmjBm8e1b4CXzYd-iV0i5UZCZhzfi7HKiJ3Zw1FNL0R7ZMLdd24fjavaKQ26vDKMkX9R4uSrOVUuLM%3D)**

I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him we're not hitting our fundraising goals.

[**CONTRIBUTE BEFORE TRUMP LANDS IN MONTANA ->**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=15c5306b0de744a6b6e264da23fd8213&_e=b4crRsGBcBMhKtEsVCQRseenCuWV3WmAExBwc-eNQHBjXfC98HhJB4pnHlgp_LTn--o-W9sjm6D9hn5EQPElEyneFwLcDdErMx0RBLRvaPhV8VbRC6YDwKb0kkeoEwrgHL96RepfoeBhOBJuttZchxhL8Yu4lpKNMLVVmYz7IBM_3XZ2SHJAOlQ05WX4eub364bG3kHCBd1FuiZbyLqFKrQoroaJNEbN_yzQud4mgp0Ts7iwfnCbP94AdpRxOw0ZOmXeKbrhUq9lBbSIgaMIMBFzTcHD_MFTw1X3nrEdiJdijXX0FhHW_nkaHYGmF8O0rQQzT9kCrHLcZKDJ5Eg_ab_FkBL44aJ2sWD3ju63z5HciQJ9xWPhJlLPPrjHuOCjL1BaGSdYDiuPCZcNZN6ruhIwLe3UgrPUu-JcDYysgxY%3D)
President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ _**How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival?**_ ”

I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month.

For America's Future,

Peter,
Earlier this year, our Arizona newsroom, _The Copper Courier_ , was the first to break an important story about _PragerU_ ’s mission to put right-wing misinformation in Arizona’s public schools.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90525729/490800149/-593472309?refcode=20240810-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTA5MzIyNzAtNzk1Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gjXQ9bdWd4-1dPgw_DsTwZA1XcQyBgRaeNdvlTMUOmI=)
_The Copper Courier, January 31, 2024_
Since that news broke, _PragerU_ has only expanded. According to a new article in the right-wing blog _Breitbart_ , “In the last year, seven states — Florida, Texas, Oklahoma, Arizona, New Hampshire, Montana, and Louisiana — have authorized PragerU videos in public school classrooms. More states will be coming on board soon.”
[**We’ll talk more about _PragerU_ and why this matters in a second, but breaking important stories like these takes a tremendous amount of resources. If you want to help us continue to inform people in news deserts around the country about the issues in their communities, can you pitch in $20?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90525730/490800150/-593472309?refcode=20240810-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTA5MzIyNzAtNzk1Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gjXQ9bdWd4-1dPgw_DsTwZA1XcQyBgRaeNdvlTMUOmI=)
If you’re not familiar, _PragerU_ is a right-wing media company that produces an educational “curriculum” for kids containing videos like “What Radical Islam and the Woke Have in Common" and "Is There Really a Climate Emergency?"
**They even have a guest course taught by Tucker Carlson.**
**In the last year,_PragerU_ has led a successful effort to lobby state Departments of Education into using their materials in public school classrooms, all the way down to the preschool level. Their materials are currently authorized for use in seven different states across the country, including Arizona.**
Their founder, Dennis Prager, recently took to _Breitbart_ to brag about _PragerU_ ’s influence in public schools as “an effective inoculation to the junk your kids are learning at most public schools.”
And he’s just getting started. In his _Breitbart_ op-ed, Prager said:
_“Week by week we’re building up a corpus of knowledge that will encompass the important ideas that have shaped and are shaping our world from ancient Israel to modern America... We share that goal — teaching traditional Judeo-Christian values — with many others. If we work together, we can repair American education and make it great again for all our students.”_
Peter – _PragerU_ will not stop until they’re in as many public schools as possible. They’re aggressively marketing their materials to state officials who make critical decisions about education policy in their states.
And that’s what makes COURIER’s work so important. With your continued support, our newsrooms can continue to hold state officials who enact these policies. Parents in these states deserve to know what their kids might be learning in school, and we’re proud to provide that service in communities where bad information is likely to spread.

body:
Any 3rd party shenanigans can't be written off, regardless of the candidate. The Electoral College has been formed around a two-party system and isn't equipped to handle the impacts of so many candidates. A billionaire-funded 3rd party vanity campaign for someone like RFK Jr. will absolutely guarantee the popular vote winner won't be president and is likely to throw the election to the U.S. House of Representatives to resolve.
Team: Our democracy is in too perilous a state to handle this kind of test. Fuel our efforts to support a popular vote standard that will end the Electoral College forever with $35 or whatever you can right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=080924_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=080924_2&amount=25]
USA Today: RFK Jr. can't win. But he and Cornel West could put Trump back in the White House. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=080924_2&amount=25]
Why do we keep raising the alarm about 3rd party candidates for President? Because the Electoral College could put an anti-voting election denier back in the White House. That's an existential threat to our democracy. Don't believe us? USA Today has the details:
" A recent series of six swing-state presidential polls offered Democrats and President Joe Biden a welcome dose of optimism. The head-to-head matchup with former President Donald Trump had Biden winning Wisconsin by a point and tied in Michigan and Pennsylvania."
"But the same Bloomberg/Morning Consult poll contained a dire warning. When minor party candidates like Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Jill Stein and Cornel West were added to the mix , Biden’s narrow lead in Wisconsin became a 2-point loss, a tie in Pennsylvania flipped to Trump by 6 points and Michigan remained dead even. Such an outcome would return Trump to the White House. "
This is the nightmare scenario come to life - and the threat is real. Our only chance is to stop their plan before it goes into action is by pitching in $35 or whatever you can to help us end the Electoral College once and for all >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=080924_2&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
