Election experts agree on three points: (1) In a head-to-head general election contest, Trump faces the same challenges to winning the popular vote as he has in the past, perhaps worse; (2) independent third-party candidates on the ballot siphoning away votes gives Trump the best possible chance of winning reelection by winning the Electoral College; and (3) Trump says he will continue to seek reelection even if he is convicted of crimes. We can’t just hope that this threat will go away or that the courts will act in time to remove Trump from the ballot.
But we do have one simple way to checkmate these efforts. The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia.
Minnesota was the latest to join, giving NPVIC 16 states plus DC, accounting for 206 electoral votes and 76% of the states needed to essentially make the popular vote the law of the land. We need to get over the top in the other states considering joining, like Maine and Michigan, to make the popular vote a reality.
We have to end this once and for all! Put us over the top by supporting our efforts to end the Electoral College forever with $35 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=080924_2&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

---

Fellow American,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note - with a follow-up yesterday - letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump today. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 88 days before Election Day.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ec05273b482b4ca5a35821ab4a9d1846&_e=j7Zz-COVgMovqpZh8BXY9KF3L6XW_Co4l6wUIAIr5MHtAaJ75En4-jys6tm45Bhz8rAj_paYYV9AHmXcfVxcAggrym1w9PtrWB1K5FNPjRXi11EYTV18wUc4M4uwtVMP25ln1xlxMy3qxsUl5-9826k7yv0S-TbVx7rswo74Rhk-aTYaMBzyFvyJ0j6LQ7h-0yQcsuYLaRJ8_dWKuzA_qWGSBwRuFcpmtldsiLa15E0GHQ4ZRi9-FknsCIm4bXRl2G8TCvp2nxU8erf6d3FXHgYGdEqySptDMOA5k-RQgrZ02IqEvM-zvd_r6j-s-nPDuz_OUl3sftXPX8v9x0_S1ZrIDoN4dzCu4jat-NSFiGODTQ15fbgYizx0g58nYJUtjooq_KppzoA3qP2YFnyYvkuygKG6gTsDTbZncIiQ2fg%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Yesterday, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

On Tuesday I set a goal of raising $50,000 before our sit-down.**[Trump is now on his way, and we’re STILL $8,733 short.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ec05273b482b4ca5a35821ab4a9d1846&_e=j7Zz-COVgMovqpZh8BXY9KF3L6XW_Co4l6wUIAIr5MHtAaJ75En4-jys6tm45Bhz8rAj_paYYV9AHmXcfVxcAggrym1w9PtrWB1K5FNPjRXi11EYTV18wUc4M4uwtVMP25ln1xlxMy3qxsUl5-9826k7yv0S-TbVx7rswo74Rhk-aTYaMBzyFvyJ0j6LQ7h-0yQcsuYLaRJ8_dWKuzA_qWGSBwRuFcpmtldsiLa15E0GHQ4ZRi9-FknsCIm4bXRlxoKULJHNG_SUrTA_CxqyNg5NW8Hiw71TVxcobfSB-FypJZQpcQi9YpB4ExHBhzHmUg1ISI870DywnWatseyVOf_vRz-Mf0qmAaiILyjbq3zRqKgg8N5jtU5YiTy19TP59dtumOl8bVFOPl5rtWAchu4C87ZMi0W7Qa0cJhLpHi4%3D)**

I can’t thank Trump for coming to Montana, then in the next breath tell him we're not hitting our fundraising goals.

[**CONTRIBUTE BEFORE TRUMP LANDS IN MONTANA ->**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ec05273b482b4ca5a35821ab4a9d1846&_e=j7Zz-COVgMovqpZh8BXY9KF3L6XW_Co4l6wUIAIr5MHtAaJ75En4-jys6tm45Bhz8rAj_paYYV9AHmXcfVxcAggrym1w9PtrWB1K5FNPjRXi11EYTV18wUc4M4uwtVMP25ln1xlxMy3qxsUl5-9826k7yv0S-TbVx7rswo74Rhk-aTYaMBzyFvyJ0j6LQ7h-0yQcsuYLaRJ8_dWKuzA_qWGSBwRuFcpmtldsiLa15E0GHQ4ZRi9-FknsCIm4bXRlPlYR1wQy4BzgXUNXayBf7yk5THpssgcAkWD_KI6oDd7StLyP22JihkclO12vud1Vn-znHKZP79UU1EOpyvJcYKnIKLimuFZR0fOtSDQR5TOS5a0EFvoYYw_ShvIldPqV3lp-9eElOK9ECAHE8OBaaRS0p1yi15dHtLW9SMcubhY%3D)
President Trump and I are both competitive people, so I know the first question he’ll ask me is, “ _**How much money did you raise in anticipation of my arrival?**_ ”

I want to look him in the eye and tell him that his visit helped flip our fortunes this month.

For America's Future,

You may have heard there's a "Debate About Debates" going on in Missouri.
But yesterday, after Josh Hawley reserved $1,000,000 in TV ads to air false attacks against me (more on that later), the truth behind this "debate" was exposed, as was the total brokenness of our politics. Here's how it happened:
First, where things stand...
I believe ALL Missourians should get to hear from us. So because Josh Hawley immediately accepted invitations for media-moderated and hosted TV debates in 2018, I thought -- despite our disagreements -- Josh and I would at least agree on this. I was wrong.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58ac5e5a-42b7-4717-918d-92799820b36d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
How'd we get here? Well let me explain...
In recent weeks, we launched TV ads to introduce me and my message to more voters. About the people who supported me growing up, my service, and my mission in this Senate race. No attacks. Just me. Like this one:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6bcf3bd6-8324-4e52-b472-f34911b54e06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then a supporter got polled...
The poll was filled with entirely false and ludicrous attacks against me, clearly Hawley and his allies testing TV ads to run against me. It was a sign our message is resonating and that Hawley's public nervousness wasn't just a fundraising fib.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a79fd3b6-12d2-46fb-b2b8-acf07de623a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But...
We still thought, as a red-state incumbent, Hawley's first ads would surely be positive, trying to tout his record. TV debates would likely be our first chance to show voters a contrast, so as we neared our primary victory on Tuesday, we prepared to call for debates.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a7197305-bafa-4793-9dfa-d36e1bd2d9b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As the race was called...
Hawley gave us a pleasant surprise -- debates starting as early as next week! We asked for at least five on TV to start. Then, stations came together to make the State Fair idea a real debate that could be televised to voters statewide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea658e3-65c5-48e0-8d36-6fcba53c1bb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But something was off...
Hawley refused to accept the offer from @KSDKNews and @KSHB41 to record and then broadcast the debate from the State Fair in Sedalia -- his own idea. And he's now claiming he'll only accept something "sponsored" by a group that endorsed him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ca690c4-a71a-41f2-b068-2d41e097422b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A quick reminder...
In 2018, Hawley immediately accepted virtually every media debate offer he got. Now, he's suddenly afraid to do any debates that are actually televised. So what's changed?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/062da0f2-2e39-425a-bdf1-9f04cfa59f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Since 2018...
Josh Hawley spent 6 years in the Senate robbing us of our liberties and tax dollars. Now he's pledged to launch a "Christian Nationalist" crusade against our freedoms in 2025. And like classic Josh Hawley, when things get tough, he'd rather skitter out the back door:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3429a5d-e933-4717-a73a-54127a7ade65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
You might be wondering...
How will Hawley slow our momentum if he won't even accept an offer for one real debate? Well, first you should know: Our broken system doesn't just let corporate donors buy elections -- it also lets candidates get away with lying.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8036d2ac-590e-44e4-812e-f188bc49342c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's why that matters...
Hawley's campaign just launched a $1,000,000 TV blitz behind this false and absurd attack ad. It's so absurd, it's obvious they even narrowed their lie to "trucks" because they clearly thought "cars" would be too cartoonish to believe!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/db6399cb-2c37-4a1a-a67a-da0a028c1d7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Josh Hawley never wanted a real televised debate. He never wanted to debate the issues in front of millions of Missourians or to be held accountable for robbing us. He's just a fraud and a coward -- the only thing he wants on TV is clips of him acting tough and false attack ads against me.
This is our chance to take this Senate seat back for real Missourians and end Josh Hawley's crusade against our freedoms.
We can't let him get away with airing $1,000,000 in false attack ads while he skitters away from debates. Please, help me raise $1,000,000 to fight back:
[DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/0674d222-c4f6-481c-b2e8-d4a3ed7a540e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---

| | Happy Friday!
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, August 9, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Aurora shuts down apartment complex, owners blame Venezuelan gang for building’s condition](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
An Aurora landlord is blaming the city’s decision to shut down an apartment complex on a Venezuelan gang — a claim that city officials dismissed, calling it an “alternative narrative” to numerous code violations and the poor condition of the building.
The landlord said it could not resume normal operations at the site because of an immediate threat of danger from the gang that staffers and residents face.
City officials insisted that Tren de Aragua, a Venezuelan prison gang known as TDA, was not responsible for issues that for months have plagued Aspen Grove Apartments at 1568 Nome St. and compelled Aurora to evict dozens of families.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Parents are pushing for better Colorado playgrounds for kids with disabilities, and even small towns are getting in on it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Berthoud, Colorado is constructing an inclusive playground, one of the most accommodating in northern Colorado, for children with disabilities, including features like adapted monkey bars and wheelchair-accessible swings.
* The initiative for this $1.6 million park was heavily supported by the local community, including significant fundraising efforts by the Bowling family, who raised over $53,000 through lemonade stands over four years.
* Larger cities in Colorado, like Denver and Loveland, are also prioritizing inclusive playgrounds, with new projects incorporating features that cater to a wide range of physical and sensory needs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Dog lover marshals animal welfare community to save four-legged friends](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The cost of living increase in Colorado has resulted in more dog surrenders and fewer adoptions, leading to overcrowded shelters where many dogs are euthanized due to behavioral or health issues.
* Elizabeth Coalson of the National Canine Advocacy Group provides resources and training to make dogs more adoptable and prevent surrender, including six weeks of free puppy training for adopters from Denver Animal Shelter.
* Coalson has also compiled low-cost resources for dog owners and created a support group offering behavioral services to help maintain dog ownership during financial hardships.
* She advocates against dog trafficking and promotes local adoptions, offering a reduced adoption fee of $25 for dogs over one year old at Denver Animal Shelter.

* Trump has scheduled debates on Fox News for September 4, ABC for September 10, and NBC for September 25, although final confirmations are pending based on the Harris campaign's agreement on these dates.
* The commitment to these debates comes after Trump initially declined a debate scheduled by ABC for September 10 with President Biden, citing ongoing litigation against ABC News's George Stephanopoulos.

**[Gaines: How the legislature performed magic to make your TABOR refund disappear](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_They take your TABOR refund, not by removing it from your hand, but by taking away the possibility there will be one in the first place.

When I’ve written in the past about gas stoves or internal combustion cars, one thing I’ve noted is that the government doesn’t necessarily outright ban those things, they merely take away your ability to find them and/or buy them.

Something similar happened this last legislative session. The state (depending on the estimates) either took your TABOR refunds for the future or it took a huge chunk of them.

And like with what I said about the stoves, they didn’t take them by direct action, that is, but taking the check out of your hand. No, they took them by taking away your ability to have them in the first place._

_They’d weigh them and they gave me cash, real cash in my hand for recycling._
_This was my first interaction with “Coors.”_
_Coors invented the completely recyclable aluminum beverage container. Now the marketplace standard, it saved more waste and pollution than an army of greenies banning shopping bags, and without any governmental mandates._ _Later in life, my interactions with Coors included sneaking into my parents’ garage to sneak cans of Coors Light._

_Previously-elected Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters is facing seven felony charges and several misdemeanors in a trial happening this week on the Western Slope. She is accused of orchestrating a breach to prove election theft. Peters has pleaded not guilty, claiming to be a victim of lawfare._
_The Colorado secretary of state’s office has refuted her claims summarized in three reports Peters has published, called the “Mesa [County] Reports.” State prosecutors allege that Peters enlisted software engineer Gerald “Jerry” Wood for IT contract work. Wood passed a background check, received his security badge, and allegedly returned it the same day. However, prosecutors claim his badge was used twice in May 2021 to access secure election facilities, capturing images of the election server’s hard drive before and after a “trusted build” update, which were then leaked online._
_On Tuesday, the star of the trial was an employee from Dominion Voting Systems, who testified with his video off. This odd choice left everyone scratching their heads, especially when the judge kept interrupting his testimony by siding with the prosecution’s objections on relevance._

clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** See Terry Goodin and Micah Beckwith Debate on Tuesday at the State Fairgrounds On Tuesday, August 13, Lieutenant Governor Candidates Democrat Terry Goodin, Libertarian Tonya Hudson, and Republican Micah Beckwith will go head to head in an agricultural-themed debate. Please arrive at or before 2 PM ET to give yourself the best chance to snag a seat. Seating is limited to the first 300 attendees. The backbone of Indiana’s economy has always been farmers, something that Democratic Candidate Terry Goodin knows well since he is a cattle farmer himself and he served as the Indiana state director for the U.S. Department of Agriculture's rural development program. Our goal is to have as many Democrats in attendance as possible, for reminders. If you’re unable to come, the live coverage provided by Hoosier Ag Today will be available on , the , the , and the . Mike Braun Voted Against Bringing Thousands of Jobs to Indiana Two years after the passage of the Biden-Harris Administration’s historic CHIPS and Science Act, the legislation is to bring over 1,000 new jobs to Indiana. This week, it was announced that South Korean Company SK Hynix has received $450 million in federal funding as a direct result of that legislation to build a chip manufacturing plant in West Lafayette. The facility is expected to boost Indiana’s economy, and that it will fill what the government has deemed is a “critical gap” in the U.S. semiconductor supply chain. This is your reminder that despite being a legislator for six years, Braun refused to work across the aisle and instead voted against the act. Clearly, he believes that an extreme, MAGA agenda is the acceptable way to govern, putting thousands of Hoosiers at a loss. To change the face of our politics, we urge you to vote for the McCormick-Goodin ticket this November. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week, U.S. Representative Frank Mrvan secured a grant worth over $128,000 to help reduce the City of LaPorte’s Fire Department’s exposure to carcinogens. The money will also provide diesel exhaust removal systems to all three of the city’s fire stations. “Congratulations to the City of La Porte Fire Department on successfully securing this vital funding to improve protections for our first responders and ensure they have the resources to safely perform their duties. I will continue to do all I can to support our selfless first responders and their essential services to protect our region,” Congressman Mrvan said in a statement. State Rep. Victoria Garcia Wilburn is prepared to continue her work on behalf of all Hoosiers working, playing, and living in Indiana’s 32nd District. She was elected in 2022, and throughout her tenure in the General Assembly she has become known for championing women’s rights, environmental protections, public safety, and access to quality education. Join Jennifer McCormick at an Upcoming Event Jennifer will be holding a Town Hall Event on Wednesday, August 14 at 6 pm at Amelio’s on the River in Logansport. Each candidate will speak about their platform and have a chance to answer questions from the audience. To stay up to date with all her events, view for more information. Get Involved! Opportunities to Volunteer Near You! The 2024 campaign season is getting started, and campaigns around the state are needing help! Find an event near you and get involved to help Upcoming Candidate Trainings Join the National Democratic Training Committee on Wednesday, August 14 from 1-2 pm ET for a free virtual live training entitled How Local Parties Prepare for (Get Out The Vote) , designed to help you mobilize and consolidate your voter base ahead of election day. Join the Stonewall Democrats for a Special Event = Join Indiana Stonewall Democrats on Wednesday, August 14 from 6-7:30 pm at the IBEW Union Hall to celebrate Party Pride with special guest Jim Obergefell, who was the named plaintiff in the SCOTUS case Obergefell v. Hodges, which secured marriage equality in the US in 2015. Interested in attending? = Meet The Indiana Rural Summit This nine-candidate supergroup is dedicated to shaking up Southern Indiana politics for the better by spreading their core message: Rural communities and small towns can have better healthcare, schools, and jobs. To do this, the candidates have launched a six-stop regional tour to connect with underrepresented voters. Want to get IN on the action? The next event will be on Aug. 15 in Scott County. Friend, your voice matters. Democracy and the right to vote is what makes America special. It's a unifying process that allows us to be represented by leaders that we choose—together. **_Making voting more difficult, engaging in partisan gerrymandering, and allowing big money to have such a pivotal role in elections are threats to our democracy, and they must be stopped._**
When I'm in the U.S. Senate, you can count on me to vote for the Freedom to Vote Act to ensure that every American can make their voice heard. [**But first, we have to win in November. Can you chip in to help our campaign make August our strongest month yet? >>**](https://cg4ut.us/l/Pc1dcwWraEi0)

Friend, I’m proud to be a lifelong climate voter and voter for the outdoors. Democracy depends on active and engaged citizens. The pictures above ⬆️ show me voting in person in 2008 and dropping off my mail-in ballot a couple of years ago. With the far-right continuing their attempts at voter disenfranchisement and **_every single Republican Senator_** voting against the Freedom to Vote Act, electing Democrats to the Senate is more important than ever. The things we need to do to win. I don’t want to do that, and I know you don’t either. Now, in a few hours, I’m going to take the stage at a rally here in Arizona. One of the biggest of this election. And it would give me a ton of peace of mind that’d we’ll hit our goals if you could chip in and help us get back on track before I do. How about it, Peter? | | Do you remember the first time you voted? Maybe it was in a presidential election, or maybe you were eager to elect someone in your community. Voting should be an empowering experience, and we hope that’s what you encountered. But maybe you faced issues in casting your vote. Maybe you found that your registration was challenged, or your polling place was closed with no warning. The wait to vote might have taken hours, or you were eventually turned away without being able to vote. It’s frustrating to have to navigate barriers to voting, and that’s why we fight to protect access to the ballot box. [**If you’ve got a story to share, we want to hear it. Maybe it was in a presidential election, or maybe you were eager to elect someone in your community. Voting should be an empowering experience, and we hope that’s what you encountered. But maybe you faced issues in casting your vote. Maybe you found that your registration was challenged, or your polling place was closed with no warning. The wait to vote might have taken hours, or you were eventually turned away without being able to vote. I studied hard to earn a scholarship that made college possible for me and dedicated my career to public service. Eventually, I ran for Congress, defeated a Republican incumbent, and became the first South American immigrant elected to the House. What if I told you that your $25 could make a real difference in flipping the House of Representatives blue?
What if I told you that $25 could help us defeat Congress' most extreme and dangerous member, Jim Jordan?
That it could help us elect a leader who truly represents our American values?
Your $25 could be the key to sending Jim Jordan packing.
Jordan, who recently scored as the least bipartisan member of Congress, has spent his career promoting a divisive and warped ideology that does nothing for Americans.
His record is a testament to partisan gridlock and inefficiency that has left working people behind.
But with your contribution, we can bring real change. Your $25 will help us run a campaign that champions effective governance, real solutions for Americans, and the promise of a brighter future for all. Unlike Jim Jordan, who votes against crucial Farm Bills every time, I will fight to ensure our farmers get the resources and support they need.

Peter, it’s Ritchie.

My story is a bit different than most members of Congress, and I want to take a moment to tell you about it. [If you’ve heard this before, here’s a chance to chip in to my people-powered re-election campaign »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90535485/490834542/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240809_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjNkYzFkNi04ZTU2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k23rnVrXexbc13NoaNwEvfiJm-vZZuBY9hdEta20h2U=)

I grew up in public housing, raised by a single mother making minimum wage, which at the time was only $4.25 per hour. I won’t lie: it was difficult. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90535486/490834543/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240809_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjNkYzFkNi04ZTU2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k23rnVrXexbc13NoaNwEvfiJm-vZZuBY9hdEta20h2U=) _Here’s a photo of me and my mom!_ I understand the struggles of New York families because I lived them myself, Peter. **When you grow up in public housing, you don’t really have the privilege to not care about politics.**

That’s why, when it comes to poverty or inequality, food insecurity or housing, mental health or LGBTQ+ rights, I don’t just think about policy — I think about my own lived experiences.

It’s _these_ lived experiences that motivate me every single time I walk into my office in D.C — _to fight for affordable housing, mental healthcare, LGBTQ+ rights, and more._

Peter, it’s not just policy, it’s _personal_ — and I refuse to give up... but I need your help to protect this seat.

Hi Peter, I’m a Wisconsin boy through and through. I was born and raised in Western Wisconsin and went to UW-Madison for college. If you asked me in person, I could talk for hours about everything I love about this great state - but here are a few of my favorites:
1. **The people.** I can’t speak highly enough about the down-to-earth, hard-working people of Wisconsin. We live in a state full of kind-hearted folks, but we mean business. We know the difference between right and wrong and fight for it. It’s so great to truly know your neighbors and community members.
2. **The food.** If you offered me a Wisconsin beer, brat, or cheese, I couldn’t turn you down. Our local businesses and family farms put in so much effort to make the best product, and you can taste it.
3. **The environment.** One of the best-kept secrets about Wisconsin is the beautiful nature that surrounds us. Our lakes and state parks are incredible places to spend time hiking, biking or just taking in the scenery.

body:
Friends, it’s Ruben Gallego here.
I know we’ve sent a number of emails your way over. But with our primary election over and the general election kicking off, I hope you understand that we’re not doing it to annoy you.
We’re sending them because emails like this are one of the single, biggest ways we fund a campaign that can win.
And today, I am asking if there is anything, anything at all that I can say to convince you to chip in to my campaign right now.
What if I told you that this will be one of the most closely contested, most expensive, most decisive elections in the entire country this year — and that we MUST win to hold the U.S. Senate?
What if I told you that Trump attacked me — personally, by name — during a rally with Kari Lake? If we’re going to defeat Trump and stop him from retaking the White House, it starts right here in Arizona.
And what if I told you that your support really, truly matters. Seriously. I’ve seen what this team can do, and with less than 100 days to go until the most important election of our lifetime, your donation is absolutely critical to our success.
Please. A lot of people have already chipped to help us reach our goals and they’re hoping you'll do the same. We are, too.
Can I count on you to split $30, or whatever you can afford today, to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona and Tim Kaine's in Virginia? There's a lot riding on our ability to show strength right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

body:
Peter,
I announced my campaign for U.S. Senate 528 days ago.
Today, I am officially the Democratic nominee.
But I didn’t do it alone. I would not be here without every person who was a part of this grassroots campaign. It was the work of tens of thousands of people who put out a yard sign, knocked doors, made phone calls, chipped in a few bucks, or cast their ballot for me in the primary.
Take a second to think about that: tens of thousands of people coming together for a better future, including you. That’s the energy we are all helping to produce across the country right now.
Thank you. I am proud of the movement we have built, and I hope that you are too.
But for all that we have accomplished so far, our real work has just begun. The 90 day sprint is officially on.
So it is going to take each and every person who got us here—and a few more!— doing their part to keep Michigan blue in November.
I will be working harder than I ever have before over these next 3 months. But I cannot do it alone. I have relied on you to get to this point.
So I’m asking for your help again. Can I count on you to split $10 between my campaign and Fight for Progress to help us get over the finish line and keep Michigan blue? name: Mondaire Jones
subject: I will fight for voting rights and our democracy.
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR BY
MONDAIRE FOR CONGRESS
body:
Just this year, Mike Lawler voted to prevent citizens from registering to vote using their driver’s license.
Team,

59 years ago this week, President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Voting Rights Act of 1965 into law. This landmark legislation outlawed many discriminatory voting practices, such as literacy tests and poll taxes, which were used primarily in southern states to disenfranchise voters of color after the Civil War.

But in 2013, the Supreme Court gutted crucial provisions in the Voting Rights Act. Since then, Republican lawmakers across the country have been working nonstop to make it harder for Americans—especially Black and brown Americans—to vote.

During my time in Congress, I stood up for voting rights. I fought to ensure every American could participate in our democratic process. I was proud to co-author the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to protect our right to vote—legislation passed by the House when we had a Democratic majority.

**[I know there’s still more work to be done to protect the right to vote for every American. I’m ready to go back to Congress to continue that fight, but I need your help. Chip in now to help me flip NY-17 and the House blue so we can protect access to the ballot box.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90536695/490838329/-150841850?refcode=em24_240809_vra_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240809_vra_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=57f71d59-9256-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1N2Y3MWQ1OS05MjU2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VuKRXLvQDGFRYEkgk5qje4OhLbjfsONFTpeLJK02m4A=)**

Today’s Republican Party has completely abandoned democracy. They’re siding with a former President who was convicted of 34 felonies and who incited a deadly insurrection in an attempt to toss out the votes of Black and brown voters in places like Georgia, Arizona, and Pennsylvania.

Their attacks haven’t slowed down. My opponent and his party continue to implement restrictions on voting rights across the country. Just this year, Mike Lawler voted to prevent citizens from registering to vote using their driver’s license. **He has shown time and time again that he is willing to disenfranchise Americans in service of pushing MAGA conspiracy theories.**

When I return to Congress, I will stop at nothing to protect our democracy. To secure every American’s right to vote, we need to retake the House and pass meaningful voting rights protections. **But we can’t achieve this without flipping NY-17.**

Johnson signed the Voting Rights Act of 1965 into law. This landmark legislation outlawed many discriminatory voting practices, such as literacy tests and poll taxes, which were used primarily in southern states to disenfranchise voters of color after the Civil War. But in 2013, the Supreme Court gutted crucial provisions in the Voting Rights Act. Since then, Republican lawmakers across the country have been working nonstop to make it harder for Americans—especially Black and brown Americans—to vote. During my time in Congress, I stood up for voting rights. I fought to ensure every American could participate in our democratic process. I was proud to co-author the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to protect our right to vote—legislation passed by the House when we had a Democratic majority. = Today’s Republican Party has completely abandoned democracy. They’re siding with a former President who was convicted of 34 felonies and who incited a deadly insurrection in an attempt to toss out the votes of Black and brown voters in places like Georgia, Arizona, and Pennsylvania. name: Bryan
subject: Act Blue Investigation
body:
If you're like me, you think there's too much money in our elections and not enough transparency. I'm working to fix this.

logo

** This week, I launched an investigation into the major Democratic fundraising platform ActBlue.
------------------------------------------------------------

We found two key loopholes that we've identified within ActBlue that could enable money laundering and fraudulent donations.

** First Loophole
------------------------------------------------------------

You know that three digit CVV code on the back of your credit card? That code prevents identity theft.

ActBlue does not require the CVV number to be utilized when making a donation using a credit card.

The Democrats platform does not require CVV to donate.

** Second Loophole
------------------------------------------------------------

We've identified that ActBlue allows donations through anonymous gift cards.

This is where people put money on a Visa or Mastercard gift card that allows individuals to be susceptible to donations made in their name, where they have no control over that situation.

That's illegal. It's a campaign finance violation.
Click Here to Read More! (https://www.foxnews.com/politics/serious-loophole-gop-widens-probe-actblue-dem-fundraising-platform-helping-harris-raise-millions)

Illegal and malicious conduct have no place in our elections.

If you're like me, you think there's too much money in our elections and not enough transparency. I'm working to bring more transparency to our elections.

On Wisconsin,

Bryan Steil

View email in browser (https://mailchi.mp/220f9a67575d/act-blue-investigation?e=e907534017)
Steil for Wisconsin, Inc. . 1818 Milton Ave # 1448 . Janesville, WI 53545-1129 . USA

#
**On August 13 th, Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes and solidify a team of Connecticut State Reps and Senators that support me and what we have been doing to build a strong bench for November's title fight. VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B. - Early Voting is available Now**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab325dd-1a85-4144-ad3d-7454a678e5c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Here are the Seven Deadly Sins of the Biden, Harris and Himes Administration:
1. _**First - They Came For Our Freedom With Unreasonable Lockdowns**_
2. _**Second - They Took Away Our Affordable Energy**_
3. _**Third - They Came After Our Children**_
4. _**Fourth - They Opened the Border to Everyone Including Terrorists, Criminals, Gang Members, Drug Dealers, Child and Sex Traffickers**_
5. _**Fifth - They Have Turned Our Healthcare System Into a Bureaucratic Overpriced System Where Patients, Doctors and Other Healthcare Providers Don 't Matter**_
6. _**Sixth - They Have Legitimized Antisemitic Riots and Physical Assaults Against Jews and Jewish Institutions**_
7. _**Seventh - Crime Pays**_

**On August 13 th, Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes and solidify a team of Connecticut State Reps and Senators that support me and what we have been doing to build a strong bench for November's title fight. VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B. - Early Voting is available Now so check your local Registrar of Voters.**
During the COVID Pandemic there was panic and fear of massive deaths. In response to that fear we surrendered our liberties and we were abused. Our lives were restricted beyond what was necessary. Businesses were either classified as essential and remained open or non essential and shut down. Houses of Worship were closed and liquor stores remained open. Vaccine mandates were arbitrarily imposed. There was no open scientific discourse regarding the pros and cons of vaccine policy regarding the medical necessity of every age group being vaccinated without any risk analysis. Dissention was censored. There was huge misinformation, including the fact that vaccines gave total immunity, when it did not, and that vaccinated people could not transmit COVID to others when they could . Vaccine immunity proved to be short lived, requiring frequent boosters. Individuals who had natural immunity should not have needed to be vaccinated. Those who resisted, lost their jobs, were ostracized and were mislabeled as radicals. Vaccines did play a beneficial role especially in the elderly, the sick and nursing home populations. More sophisticated risk benefit analysis, including the risk of myocarditis, should have been done in the younger populations. The lessons to be learned are not to give up our liberty so freely, to take it back as quickly as possible and to make healthcare policy based on scientific facts, where all sides of the issue have a fair chance to be heard.
**Second They Took Away Our Affordable Energy**
Almost immediately after Biden took office his radical changes in our energy policy caused the price of gasoline to almost triple, the price of heating oil tripled and natural gas prices rose significantly. High electric prices soon followed. High grocery prices and consumer prices followed suit. But team Biden including Himes did nothing to stop the economic harm caused by these skyrocketing energy costs. In fact their only solution is for us to buy overpriced solar panels mostly made in China with huge government subsidies paid for by taxpayers and electric utility rate payers. Many people are struggling to make ends meet and many are going into debt thanks to bad policies. Our nuclear power plants are from the 1970's and we need new cost effective mini-nuclear power plants. Access to enough cheap natural gas are blocked by federal laws that need to be changed. None of this pain had to happen. Let's return to affordable energy and increased domestic production rather than import higher priced oil from dictators
T**hird They Came After Our Children**
During the pandemic schools were closed for too long. Education became more political the focused on the skills necessary to function in a 21st Century economy. Schools have become more like indoctrination centers. Parental rights are being taken away and when parents protest they are labeled domestic terrorist. Puberty blocking hormones which cause irreversible harm have been banned in the UK and are being given without parental knowledge or consent. Children in minority districts are given substandard educations not because of the amount spent on education but instead because of poorly run schools. School choice and voucher programs are needed so that education becomes competitive and parents have better options for their children's future than a failing school system.
**Fourth They Opened the Border to Everyone Including Terrorists, Criminals, Gang Members, Drug Dealers, Child and Sex Traffickers**
It is believed that 20 million illegals have entered the country. We are supporting many of them with free housing, free food, free clothing, free medical care, spending allowances and free education for their children. They are doing better than some of our veterans and many working class citizens. This makes no sense and we the taxpayers are footing the bill. No country in the world besides us is letting this happen. Crime is up, taxes to pay for this are up and we are sending the message that crime pays. The real end game is to make these illegals citizens so that with your tax dollars you are creating a voter block that will ensure that those who do not act in our best interests get elected.
**Fifth They Have Turned Our Healthcare System Into a Bureaucratic Overpriced System Where Patients, Doctors and Other Healthcare Providers Don 't Matter**
Medical care is about a patient seeing their doctor or other healthcare provider for the purpose of curing them through treatment or surgery or managing a chronic illness to improve quality of life and longevity. The doctor is supposed to be the patient advocate fighting for what is best for the patient. In the new world the doctor works for the hospital which is more focused on economics than patient interest. Patients can no longer easily contact their doctor except through a patient portal. Patients who need urgent but not emergency care do not have easy ways to schedule urgent appointments and are forced to go to Urgent Care Centers who do not have access to the patient's medical center and often do not have a physician, physician's assistant or nurse practitioner who has the specific expertise to manage specialty based medical problems. Or the go to an emergency room where they will spend hours, go through many processes that have nothing to do with their urgent issue and waste healthcare dollars on this very expensive process. Healthcare needs to reverse course and return its focus on the patient and prioritizing cost effective quality care over bureaucratic regulations and institutional roadblocks. In the end this will reduce costs and improve quality.
**Sixth They Have Legitimized Antisemitic Riots and Physical Assaults Against Jews and Jewish Institutions**
Never in recent American history have we seen antisemitic riots that turn violent, destroy property and physical violence against Jews. All of this is being tolerated because the protesters are democrat voters who are needed to win elections in swing states. This is morally repulsive and this hate will escalate. Jews will be the first victims but never the last. There are paid agitators and non citizens participating in these riots. The paid agitators should be arrested and the non citizens should be deported. When these protests violate the law there needs to be arrests and prosecutions. That is not happening in the Biden, Harris, Himes world.
**Seventh Crime Pays**
In the upside world of the Biden, Harris and Himes team the criminals are the victims and the victims are not entitled to justice. There have been violent criminals who are released after arrest and commit additional violent crimes. Finally when they are caught committing murder they are finally arrested. How many lives have been lost due these policies. Shoplifting can put stores out of business and at the least cause stores to raise prices. But somehow the shoplifters are victims. To make matters worse they want to defund the police, they have removed qualified immunity which puts a police officer at risk for doing their job.
**All of the Harmful and Destructive Polices of the Biden , Harris and Himes Team Need to Be Reversed**
Lockdowns must never happen again. The economic survival of many Americans is dependent on restoring affordable energy. Parental rights and school choice will ensure a brighter future for our children. The borders must be closed, the criminals must be deported and we must defund illegal aliens. Patients must come first and bureaucracy must be cut back to lower costs and improve care. Physician and other healthcare professionals cannot continue to work in an environment that is causing widespread burnout. Antisemitic riots and unpunished violations of our Civil Rights and criminal laws must come to an end. Criminals must be prosecuted the power of the police to enforce the law must return.

VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B. - Early Voting is available Now so check your local Registrar of Voters. During the COVID Pandemic there was panic and fear of massive deaths. In response to that fear we surrendered our liberties and we were abused. Our lives were restricted beyond what was necessary. Businesses were either classified as essential and remained open or non essential and shut down. Houses of Worship were closed and liquor stores remained open. Vaccine mandates were arbitrarily imposed. There was no open scientific discourse regarding the pros and cons of vaccine policy regarding the medical necessity of every age group being vaccinated without any risk analysis. Dissention was censored. There was huge misinformation, including the fact that vaccines gave total immunity, when it did not, and that vaccinated people could not transmit COVID to others when they could . Vaccine immunity proved to be short lived, requiring frequent boosters. Individuals who had natural immunity should not have needed to be vaccinated. Those who resisted, lost their jobs, were ostracized and were mislabeled as radicals. Vaccines did play a beneficial role especially in the elderly, the sick and nursing home populations. More sophisticated risk benefit analysis, including the risk of myocarditis, should have been done in the younger populations. The lessons to be learned are not to give up our liberty so freely, to take it back as quickly as possible and to make healthcare policy based on scientific facts, where all sides of the issue have a fair chance to be heard. Second They Took Away Our Affordable Energy Almost immediately after Biden took office his radical changes in our energy policy caused the price of gasoline to almost triple, the price of heating oil tripled and natural gas prices rose significantly. High electric prices soon followed. High grocery prices and consumer prices followed suit. But team Biden including Himes did nothing to stop the economic harm caused by these skyrocketing energy costs. In fact their only solution is for us to buy overpriced solar panels mostly made in China with huge government subsidies paid for by taxpayers and electric utility rate payers. Many people are struggling to make ends meet and many are going into debt thanks to bad policies. Our nuclear power plants are from the 1970's and we need new cost effective mini-nuclear power plants. Access to enough cheap natural gas are blocked by federal laws that need to be changed. None of this pain had to happen. Let's return to affordable energy and increased domestic production rather than import higher priced oil from dictators Third They Came After Our Children During the pandemic schools were closed for too long. Education became more political the focused on the skills necessary to function in a 21st Century economy. Schools have become more like indoctrination centers. Parental rights are being taken away and when parents protest they are labeled domestic terrorist. Puberty blocking hormones which cause irreversible harm have been banned in the UK and are being given without parental knowledge or consent. Children in minority districts are given substandard educations not because of the amount spent on education but instead because of poorly run schools. School choice and voucher programs are needed so that education becomes competitive and parents have better options for their children's future than a failing school system. Fourth They Opened the Border to Everyone Including Terrorists, Criminals, Gang Members, Drug Dealers, Child and Sex Traffickers It is believed that 20 million illegals have entered the country. We are supporting many of them with free housing, free food, free clothing, free medical care, spending allowances and free education for their children. They are doing better than some of our veterans and many working class citizens. This makes no sense and we the taxpayers are footing the bill. No country in the world besides us is letting this happen. Crime is up, taxes to pay for this are up and we are sending the message that crime pays. The real end game is to make these illegals citizens so that with your tax dollars you are creating a voter block that will ensure that those who do not act in our best interests get elected. Fifth They Have Turned Our Healthcare System Into a Bureaucratic Overpriced System Where Patients, Doctors and Other Healthcare Providers Don 't Matter Medical care is about a patient seeing their doctor or other healthcare provider for the purpose of curing them through treatment or surgery or managing a chronic illness to improve quality of life and longevity. The doctor is supposed to be the patient advocate fighting for what is best for the patient. In the new world the doctor works for the hospital which is more focused on economics than patient interest. Patients can no longer easily contact their doctor except through a patient portal. Patients who need urgent but not emergency care do not have easy ways to schedule urgent appointments and are forced to go to Urgent Care Centers who do not have access to the patient's medical center and often do not have a physician, physician's assistant or nurse practitioner who has the specific expertise to manage specialty based medical problems. Or the go to an emergency room where they will spend hours, go through many processes that have nothing to do with their urgent issue and waste healthcare dollars on this very expensive process. Healthcare needs to reverse course and return its focus on the patient and prioritizing cost effective quality care over bureaucratic regulations and institutional roadblocks. In the end this will reduce costs and improve quality. All of this is being tolerated because the protesters are democrat voters who are needed to win elections in swing states. This is morally repulsive and this hate will escalate. Jews will be the first victims but never the last. There are paid agitators and non citizens participating in these riots. The paid agitators should be arrested and the non citizens should be deported. When these protests violate the law there needs to be arrests and prosecutions. That is not happening in the Biden, Harris, Himes world. Seventh Crime Pays In the upside world of the Biden, Harris and Himes team the criminals are the victims and the victims are not entitled to justice. There have been violent criminals who are released after arrest and commit additional violent crimes. Finally when they are caught committing murder they are finally arrested. How many lives have been lost due these policies. Shoplifting can put stores out of business and at the least cause stores to raise prices. But somehow the shoplifters are victims. To make matters worse they want to defund the police, they have removed qualified immunity which puts a police officer at risk for doing their job. All of the Harmful and Destructive Polices of the Biden , Harris and Himes Team Need to Be Reversed Lockdowns must never happen again. The economic survival of many Americans is dependent on restoring affordable energy. Parental rights and school choice will ensure a brighter future for our children. The borders must be closed, the criminals must be deported and we must defund illegal aliens. Patients must come first and bureaucracy must be cut back to lower costs and improve care. Physician and other healthcare professionals cannot continue to work in an environment that is causing widespread burnout. Antisemitic riots and unpunished violations of our Civil Rights and criminal laws must come to an end. Peter, **A long-feared regional war is looming in the Middle East** and could easily spin out of control into a wider conflict. The Biden-Harris administration is pouring gasoline on the fire by sending massive arms and troops to back Israel, whose aggressive actions have long been pushing for expanded war. Tensions have remained sky-high this week. An attack on a US base in Iraq wounded at least 7. Russia is sending air defense and radar systems to its ally Iran. Today, a top Iranian commander stated that the “clear and explicit” orders of Iran’s leader to punish Israel for the assassination of Ismail Haniyeh in Tehran “will be carried out”. **The Biden-Harris administration must act to stop this at once and fix the crisis at its source - by ceasing all weapons and support to Israel until it ends its genocide in Gaza** and agrees to negotiate a settlement for Palestine and the region consistent with international law and the rulings of the International Court of Justice. After Israel’s back-to-back assassinations in Beirut and Tehran last week, Iran has met with allies including Hamas, Hezbollah, Islamic Jihad, Yemen and Iraqi militias to plan joint action against Israel and US bases in Iraq and Syria. By responding with warships, destroyers, fighter jets and potentially land-based missile defense and troops, the US is proposing to take direct part in the imminent war that could easily go nuclear. Some Israeli leaders have already suggested using nuclear weapons. Such a war could trigger nuclear winter - a reduction in sunlight due to debris from nuclear explosions suspended in the upper atmosphere for years, which can cause global famine with the potential to end civilization as we know it. By funding and arming Israel, and refusing to rein in its rampage, the Biden-Harris administration is now putting Americans and the world in the crosshairs of Israel’s genocidal aggression. The US must not be dragged into a disastrous regional war by an Israeli government seeking cover to continue its genocide in Gaza. **It’s long past time for the US to end the genocide in Gaza that it is enabling.** The US is providing the vast majority of weapons being used by Israel in Gaza, as well as financial assistance, intelligence and diplomatic cover. By halting all support for Israel’s genocide, the US can make an emergency diplomatic appeal to Iran and allies to hold their fire. By allowing Israel to determine US foreign policy in its most basic form - in matters of war and peace - the Biden-Harris administration has effectively handed the role of Commander-in-Chief to Bibi Netanyahu. This is an intolerable betrayal of the American people and it must come to an end. **With the last ballot access deadlines looming in the next few weeks, we are going all out to give voters across the country the choice to vote against endless war and genocide, and for a peaceful, just, and livable future for our children.[If you share that vision, please pitch in whatever you can today to help make it a reality.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0809_mideast_war&n=2)**

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39021%2E3422442%2E5ZTbQi)
Derek, it’s Katie Porter.
A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
**Since that day, I’ve said clearly—if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.**
As Members of the House, we are one vote of 435. That often means only a fraction of the bills we want to pass will ever become law. **But we all have a choice to make when it comes to corporate PAC money.** As Members of Congress, we’re privileged to be in positions of power, and we should use our power to stand up to the status quo and corporate special interests.
But unfortunately, this attitude isn’t the norm in Washington. Too many politicians are beholden to corporate PAC and lobbyist money and a system of legalized corruption. Our housing crisis, climate change, and rising prices are a direct result of this system, which puts corporate profits ahead of people.
**That’s why I started Truth to Power, an organization dedicated to supporting Democrats who reject corporate PAC money.** These candidates can only compete because of grassroots support, and so your donation helps us make all the difference. **[I hope you’ll consider joining me by giving a $5 contribution to Truth to Power today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240809?refcode=em20240809-39021&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39021_3422442_5ZTbQi&akid=39021%2E3422442%2E5ZTbQi)**

Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

body:
Our one year anniversary!
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240809&t=1&akid=1041%2E587540%2E6fUWNI)
Peter,
Today marks one year since Kevin and I launched Leaders We Deserve – and it’s been one hell of a ride.
This time last year we had no money and only 3,000 of my personal Gmail contacts to build a list from. (Which I didn’t realize would include some of my ex-girlfriends. Yikes, sorry about that.) But you all showed up and made this dream a reality.
One year ago, we envisioned an organization designed to build a new political movement aimed at electing bold, young progressive leaders to state and federal office. And we got to work right away!
We’re living in a time of violence, hatred, and environmental destruction. Our elected leaders have failed to respond to the cries of the future generation. Young people nowadays envision a future where kids can go to school without getting gunned down — nothing too radical, right?
Conservatives have long realized the importance of the state legislature and have weakened Democratic governors with legislation, used gerrymandering to benefit themselves, and relied on dark money to intentionally weaken the government and empower corporate America, but progressives have lagged behind in the critical work of building a strong bench of leaders to carry our fight into the future.
But now, thanks to Leaders We Deserve, we’re taking back elections from corporations and putting the fate of our nation back in the hands of the people. And we’re electing the young, courageous leaders who will fight for our progressive values for years to come.
**With the support of folks like you, Peter, we’ve created one of the most influential national movements in just ONE year.** And we’re _**not slowing down.**_
So far, Leaders We Deserve has helped inspiring candidates like Nadarius Clark and Molly Cook secure seats in positions of power. Where already Nadarius killed a bill to arm teachers AND passed a gun safety law despite Virginia having a Republican governor.
Now, we’re approaching one of the most important elections in American history, and we have an amazing slate of candidates that we’re getting elected up-and-down the ballot.
**[In honor of Leaders We Deserve turning one, can you donate $5? We’ve had an amazing year, Peter, but we can’t let the momentum slow down now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240809?refcode=em20240809&amount=5&refcode2=1041_587540_6fUWNI&akid=1041%2E587540%2E6fUWNI)**

Looking forward to another year with you,
**David Hogg**
Co-founder
Leaders We Deserve

| | **We Need America-First Republicans 🙏**
---
| |
---
Frustration is growing over America’s relentless funding of terrorism—and if you ask me, it ought to be the biggest dadgum story on the news. A government watchdog organization recently released information that’s left me gobsmacked: Since 2021, the UN and a host of other groups have funneled a mind-blowing [$3.8 billion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4f6be37f31bb44f791f7251055a3a396&_e=-wHODFOBLi8gcG5_2LABsNpwI9YwbwudES6_LlTwfJp_OM629hA-d21GhANWVUZl_x0T0-XgXnj2dBleRQ2qnKH_al4b-J0Sa0qZCzTP7rzC5wZkUXgejx6vHZFO3r4cZbsXzXGv1mc-XiKGaIv2Upc16cAGthnbrLrD-w8Jm91VN8-4FS9Zyeler6euyC6M5XnTsyTaxG6iFpK-RGjq45tGjz_W_siYcCf-z59Y7ddKXxyjWahooa7VzYc1LxWec72zhG4Jf_VbpAK3G5jgEcMpHToneXatnag8yf_G82DHZlTMqQxh7W6YLX7FOfqC) U.S. dollars into Taliban-led Afghanistan. Veterans are outraged, everyday Americans are furious, and I refuse to sit back and watch this happen—these terrorists don’t deserve another red cent. That’s why I introduced the [No Tax Dollars for the Taliban Act](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4f6be37f31bb44f791f7251055a3a396&_e=-wHODFOBLi8gcG5_2LABsJID3lTX3QDje0RfYq1XfY8o7HZwcXDD3oVhS9wxlDbKWgPZZiKHNYgOkX5wqETYgkbSDAZO4PvypHwI1ZtiEdCK684bcSCg5ag2xWVqvN83VS-9ZP2mso-I-XQUrQq7qKgEFpjjEEkY43Cds-gvtXF-iTkKvGI-Tpk54uXyi1YRN53mCrSlDKzRSQTBNUe5mNmQlvq4oEV3N7CL7npWA2TbnNCstR1XoUevMMyI7-pCHyt8rM0wPysUuC1MTXwu5QJyTTqc8ECluNSlccwPtBM%3D) to slam the brakes on this insanity, and while it passed in the House, it’s now stuck in legislative limbo while Congress takes yet another vacation. As I mentioned on my podcast, Tennessee Talks, it’s like these folks are allergic to work. We started August recess a week early, leaving critical legislation like this to gather dust. Meanwhile, we’ve just hit the [$35 trillion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4f6be37f31bb44f791f7251055a3a396&_e=-wHODFOBLi8gcG5_2LABsAuL1ybB7RG19b_8o9xn3BtGWGaqRQCsvlz5SqPdtqY_UANmNuW_vcK0oLcYCexN5Q_TQGna6TH8ogbRe3XpE4txn4aH7A55xhhSkP-g8gHKlizPAdjA8XNafFfaShq1yvEpm9Z1047sdN_PzOQVOjT98c8-Xo_-_O07mkRZvkaQv2I_ZrRmtG0QV6iJK4qMmMxJgO_H5nGXOnhQipqtzYkgo7jq8_yUBVcYpfGqhPlkkSz2gXgu1SmnzKxyLt_R2Q%3D%3D) mark in America’s debt crisis—all thanks to irresponsible spending like this. Every dollar is borrowed, and every dollar we take limits Americans’ ability to earn a living and save for the future. This isn’t just about passing a bill—it’s about restoring faith in our government by telling the world that America will no longer be an ATM for evil terrorists. And after all our [veterans ](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4f6be37f31bb44f791f7251055a3a396&_e=-wHODFOBLi8gcG5_2LABsPxZQSn6RqJiy9rwHJx9elb1l4_tArIfRx3b7ygG80GcnUxXJorOkzn91_D1sDYQuIrcs1QlpS5HBP0oabU7FLFtlDtE6jZPaX1SuT8HuynnTkMas5AdCii1Jj14MakIvxkZnWmCgJAaT1PYARJ2RXclfOA0g6W83or_VH3FwMExz48dqPkBDcX0CIbtzbOl6wXAjhTpeRs5rxHNTT90zOUTKoHlUiNoDEiH1_y37WTacOQ25hMz4zYIF8y2BLdm4_b7WuxzAxSCmG2lC-YPdoFPKHY_W1CQi-E6zpAlfhfEyXyMSY7wnTaRcCRse848WQ%3D%3D)sacrificed over in Afghanistan, it’s the very least we can do to honor their service. So, how do we untangle this mess? How do we pass meaningful legislation on time? The answer is clear as day: We need to elect more America-first Republicans. Our [razor-thin majority](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4f6be37f31bb44f791f7251055a3a396&_e=-wHODFOBLi8gcG5_2LABsOS5EBIevMfK3_ZbUTbgpbZotJ0ov-MgVLVyCcNPoAeY6bvQbkZp7YL2S8urPFXJu7M309mwnSuIt1fF0rH7pNdOEkY2Miqoh1mQL8dfuNGDHt41i-rnMNkFjQSx3bvkmC7IfSDEXk_08rm1X0Jn7nviLzM7beKYzEEEftmotXZGtIKfAmHkFflyQOobz7xHEjFtTYgalxVqr7CGPbU5YsD6meeXqi7b1pXJVs3jWH9s4Pu1n_CNjbrtYXajoFl3nDkZ3WTZL5861rSA6DJ7aHE%3D) isn’t cutting it. The Speaker is always on edge, wondering whether he’ll have the votes to push anything of substance through. It’s time to get our values back on track in Washington. We can’t kick the can down the road as America bleeds money, putting our future on the line. We need representatives who will fight tooth and nail to put an end to reckless spending and ensure that every dollar spent serves the interests of our constituents.
---

---
| | **Taking Care of District Business 🧡**
---
| |
---
| | If there’s any bright side to this August recess, it’s that it gives me time to tend to things back in the district. ## Alaska Belongs to You—Not to Washington Power Brokers.

Dear Friends,

**"Comply! Do not resist! National special interests have selected your candidates."**

These are the unspoken commands from the political elites pouring over $200,000 a day into Alaska. Their mission? To knock me off your ballot. Why? Because I’m the only candidate who threatens their carefully crafted plans, the only candidate dedicated to putting Alaskans first and challenging the power plays of Washington insiders.

Let’s be clear: The political establishment has chosen their candidates—candidates who will comply with their agenda and uphold the status quo. But Alaskans know better. We’ve always fought for our independence and our right to shape our own future. That’s what this election is truly about.

Here’s what you need to know:
* **I’m speaking out against Ranked Choice Voting** , a confusing system designed to weaken conservative voices and benefit political insiders.
* **I’m funded primarily by Alaskans.** Over 99% of our campaign contributions come from individual supporters like you, not from PACs or out-of-state special interests.
* **I’m committed to a true Republican primary** where the top vote-getter advances, ensuring your voice is heard without interference.
* **I’m endorsed by 20+ grassroots conservative clubs and districts across Alaska.** These endorsements represent the real, authentic voices of our state.

This election is about whether Alaskans will allow Washington power brokers to dictate our choices or whether we will stand up and reclaim our future. I refuse to be a puppet for national special interests, and I know you feel the same way.

As we approach August 20th, I need your support—your voice, your vote, and your commitment to a brighter future for Alaska. Together, let’s send a clear message that Alaska is **Not. For. Sale.**

Make sure your voice is heard. Vote on or before August 20th, go to [https://elections.alaska.gov/avo](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=d05ca014b2&e=6679001ba0) to find an early voting location, or how to vote absentee by mail.

Let’s show them that Alaskans cannot be bought, bullied, or ignored. Together, we will take back our state and ensure it remains a place where freedom, independence, and true representation thrive.

Thank you for standing with me in this fight. Together, we will win.

**America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Best regards,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress

Friend,

A year ago, I began investigating the Democrat fundraising powerhouse, ActBlue.

It was one of OMG’s first investigations, and **[I could use your support to keep it going](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxkjzHP0zAQhn_NZUsUnx27GTwAVZFAYmCCCTnxuTXk6nyO81X598hVxcJ4zz16717H6xLDYcF8BMRb9BsggvwAiG8_H5z33_z1c_v9y4_39k1_46Fu8RMglmOlf-orpSN2canUnBtvZfC9asgKgxJVr5VobjaE8eRp0L06CdKTnLzAYPTJzxPJacQmWuxR9ad-RDEYoTqpMPjRiBHNYHQIoPrnnc4x5Tg7sZWHyzkl7ubEzWJvpazb87EL4GWjec_UuTv5VKoBeEl_iAIx-eiuOe1rRXxt-dgK5aPldKej5alNDPKyF_61pT3PBPL8nwaoq1Czdn4KL1Io1_mRxQvMjlcXr3eQZ54AteO03wvIMw5Ntn59xGWJmzag-uuzX23zbvFvAAAA__-RqIWQ).**

Millionaires, Billionaires, and even hostile foreign countries have influenced our elections for decades. **Remember “Chinagate” that helped Bill and Hillary get into the White House?**

[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxkjzHP0zAQhn_NZUsUnx27GTwAVZFAYmCCCTnxuTXk6nyO81X598hVxcJ4zz16717H6xLDYcF8BMRb9BsggvwAiG8_H5z33_z1c_v9y4_39k1_46Fu8RMglmOlf-orpSN2canUnBtvZfC9asgKgxJVr5VobjaE8eRp0L06CdKTnLzAYPTJzxPJacQmWuxR9ad-RDEYoTqpMPjRiBHNYHQIoPrnnc4x5Tg7sZWHyzkl7ubEzWJvpazb87EL4GWjec_UuTv5VKoBeEl_iAIx-eiuOe1rRXxt-dgK5aPldKej5alNDPKyF_61pT3PBPL8nwaoq1Czdn4KL1Io1_mRxQvMjlcXr3eQZ54AteO03wvIMw5Ntn59xGWJmzag-uuzX23zbvFvAAAA__-RqIWQ)

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I have a meeting with President Trump this afternoon, and he will ask me how much money I’m raising. |
---

Peter,

On Tuesday, I sent you a quick note - with a follow-up yesterday - letting you know I have a sit-down with President Trump today. In case you missed it, **[I wrote to let you know that my campaign isn’t raising enough money relative to what we should be just 88 days before Election Day.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=9a7e1346e3d34e0085473ea4a0ff04b5&_e=YM_lIXgPOP4sXo4efbWj0Yzl-pUpwqM58cyWzRQQ1y8W0iJlpSLmL_YdJ6nwAFb3sXKVLarUnUOkyJthyz6zTtws8DP6mSCQ9XbH3qdEH5-oyW4wyScRWimFIOOMbPYTOtgBijD0VgYwkbLouOV8NZmWkAk2EIVTQEH-erko5d0iH1tITnWBjsLSHT7FwwLvOF0XuLF5HuYQu6DZTlbWBaZ2yL5my_vidM13U0Ry7Jrfozk_C72GIpBPtS61EKR3IQ_kbgpQIOdGLnOGM5iUDV1jhQp5MVtms1x5boME0v2cRNHn6s0UFXF8gINmsHHBIt0Qom9Kl0NjY8RU1WEfMxv-ZldnKWFcAnCrw7gxH9VRF0IJ6FISv6M22kb950-pPRmdeGcSCjsg0P3woW_KYQOYcqbDo8jJwqrDVJkVb5U%3D)**

President Trump isn’t coming to Montana because he thinks he needs to shore up support for his campaign here; he’s coming to Montana because, like me, he knows the Senate majority runs through our state.

The proof is in the polling. **Yesterday, Emerson College Polling released a survey showing my race in a statistical tie with Jon Tester, but Trump leading Harris by 15 points. **

Friend, Sonya Massey should still be alive. Last month, after Sonya called 911 for help, a police officer killed her in her home. Too many Black Americans, including Black women and girls like Sonya Massey and Breonna Taylor and Detroit’s Aiyana Mo'Nay Stanley-Jones, have been killed by racist police in their homes. To cover up their killing of Sonya, police at first lied to her family and others, blaming a neighbor and then saying she killed herself. A doctor’s homicide ruling and their own bodycam footage revealed the truth. Sonya’s father said: “If it were not for that camera footage... they would have lied their way right out of this.” Police regularly lie to hide their state-funded violence and to coerce people into false confessions.**** For example, after police used coercive tactics to get false confessions from Black and brown teenagers known as the Central Park Five, the young people were wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for years. **Children and adolescents are particularly susceptible to police coercion, leading to a higher rate of false confessions, wrongful convictions, and wrongful imprisonment.** The practice of lying to suspects (even adult suspects) is illegal in many other countries. We cannot allow this cruel practice of exploiting children’s vulnerabilities to continue. In my home state of Michigan, State Rep. clean_body: Standing up against state-funded violence. | | | Friend, Sonya Massey should still be alive. Last month, after Sonya called 911 for help, a police officer killed her in her home. Too many Black Americans, including Black women and girls like Sonya Massey and Breonna Taylor and Detroit’s Aiyana Mo'Nay Stanley-Jones, have been killed by racist police in their homes. To cover up their killing of Sonya, police at first lied to her family and others, blaming a neighbor and then saying she killed herself. A doctor’s homicide ruling and their own bodycam footage revealed the truth. Sonya’s father said: “If it were not for that camera footage... they would have lied their way right out of this.” Police regularly lie to hide their state-funded violence and to coerce people into false confessions.** For example, after police used coercive tactics to get false confessions from Black and brown teenagers known as the Central Park Five, the young people were wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for years. Children and adolescents are particularly susceptible to police coercion, leading to a higher rate of false confessions, wrongful convictions, and wrongful imprisonment. The practice of lying to suspects (even adult suspects) is illegal in many other countries. We cannot allow this cruel practice of exploiting children’s vulnerabilities to continue. In my home state of Michigan, State Rep. Dylan Wegela introduced a law to prevent police from lying to minors during interrogations. Already the states of California, Delaware, Illinois, Oregon, and Utah have passed legislation. Now we need Congress to act to protect young people nationwide. | Thank you for standing up against state-funded violence at home and abroad. Together, we will keep demanding safety for all people. Friend, I wanted to send you a quick note before you call it a night.
I'll be completely honest with you: When I reached out earlier today, I didn't think we were going to hit tonight's $35,000 midnight goal. **But after thousands of folks across Nevada and the country donated to help, we've made incredible progress – and we're _nearly_ there!**

Peter,

July was here and gone before we knew it. Less than 90 days remain until the November election and we’re making the most of each day left. Take a look at some of my favorite memories from around the district last month:

* * *
**UPDATES FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL**
* * *

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbSj5qVgzM5rc6mhJDHhsKfpXe47w4KY2oXbem9bsvqVx1pGOl6t4gR1Ek7vZ8jYxQXRGPWyMOlCtynSHhJb49saMdGMY6-CdeiKw7sBuRFqgXpde4faYQaaCp7kmP4MRG1BYW6kQIKyiaC2-F1R5l9j63jjJQdVlhFvZiYEXgysZZlCCM52lbiPWXjwGubzk4%3D)
The best part of traveling around our beautiful state is meeting so many fired-up New Mexicans. Hearing the stories from the people we meet inspire me to go the extra mile!

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-fa0MAlPJTJkJOrGXlozLGHfQOJYBB3DfpzvRKdSOcgwLDku-tNXlEg80HcGxX3L6ZxaaM06e7hoI1zfCKKRlcy3ZhDkPmPRfAcziVyY4wJUM5Rs60v9q_3ABaC5SBzZCl9PupNdujaSrAjd4lZdbjVuS93EvWl2aEYwdbuP_k3g%3D) [](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-9CVv2swu1aoHgcS_HJeD4q2pJXkTVGmy63EaMBskqSqFh6o14rGBtXL70PtXnYdWzXQZR5l4Jd1pbUDUQfrr9NdM6uvD7DibkDTZgS5_he3DYuc1j_k-2H77sb-fDIU45VqntFZgnqSDFE0anD2QqxKqBCvdsoZAOOtVzs2s8OM%3D)
We had an incredible door knocking team for our Super Saturday in Silver City. I may have had too much fun – stopping to shoot some hoops. P.S. I made the shot.

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-NdCQ1CA1GjxukF63CrgAPoDHeJ8-P-I5Z3NtJiHH8vHwkFVtT_CZ7PRcJFcL460KCfebUH8bT6RvQg_NPcAwK-lu6KFMW3tQe_40WtqSoUTGXjPWtT8VSayFBoAkBCImVDj1QjwOsYbSq1-OD5_nK26ufr8nzaHGQl97_BpXlG4%3D)
Grant County’s annual Freedom Dinner was an amazing success, selling out the room and bringing together Western New Mexico’s great communities to celebrate freedom and liberty.

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-IVQ-bFuyA4_RXJn3iEnvibFj0HAVYx6cyjEpaqk7YIvXtjL8Lx32pTPeP8c9SHvtHZdRlGomhrKioP2mjvFMWcObXdniUFsQirr659ssmqNw9u5xlVpobW5cRJyMIaJuw_dx7TK0qPyvk77KJaHeA4f4T8FhV1sWEe8tf-Klvt0%3D)
Last month, we had an incredible grand opening of our new office in the South Valley of Albuquerque. Stop by to get a yard sign, bumper sticker, t-shirt or dog bandana. Reach out to Waylon@YvetteHerrel.com or Halle@YvetteHerrell.com

[](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-b9yBG3v33HIGSrTzJyj72qjttlWbk8Q-LoONBdiIueFwc4nNSEvT8nuX2CY6grsN-iBJs5P3Eu1BEUewP75_xL_dVEfSUgHHIrp5llhIj4ugJsJ79I_mL11xRl9NVHfLsBz5ioNQ32WQ6xKcY7Ym1-u0sP3G5H4hMH4skPon-nU%3D) [](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=53bfd23dd11041558c6aafd2da193358&_e=Ks_fvG-UZA95xqg_UxJhckb_X-hLb9P-RA_-FHy4pmbZQ9DEwDLwJ6s14Ofk6Vj-5WMQaZd7oAawBSdHSJ9JVBwMYcjBkCpSdXCkda3rY4p6nRicVfnnnRU-UrZy4USC8EXRvJVPBMQg2JUfd00zgY3GmluliVdiSrqtSdWC9YtGl0WBGyK8890PI1cvJupvgc4IKQlwkaTgSSa-oSbaQBdXBMVRYGuP-VQ-Laf4mak%3D)

| Together, we can win this fight.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=3289%2E35263%2EmEL-gg)
Peter — I’d like to take this opportunity to tell you a little bit more about myself, and why my authentic self is at the heart of everything I do. When I came out in college, I knew that I wanted to pursue a career in public service. But I struggled with a serious choice: following the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. I saw others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, celebrating who they are, and being proud about who they love. That’s when I came to realize that my strength lies in being honest about who I am, which only further fueled my passion for public service. So thanks to the support of this remarkable team, I was elected as the first openly gay Senator in our Nation’s history. **But I didn’t run for office to make history — I ran to make a difference.** I knew that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. Folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. And although we’ve made incredible progress, we’re at risk of losing it all. Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. My right-wing opponent threatens to advance an extreme and dangerous agenda on a national level. And he’d be backed by a majority that has made anti-LGBTQ+ policies the hallmark of their platform if Republicans succeed in taking back control of the Senate. **It’s going to take all of us to counter these hateful attacks.
